body{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#edf6f3,#dcebe8 72%,#f8faf8)!important;color:#21363b;}
#app{width:min(1450px,96vw)!important;padding:10px 10px 14px!important;}
.screen.frame{min-height:calc(100vh - 22px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(24,68,74,.12);background:rgba(249,252,251,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);}
#home,#choose,#launch,#play,#end{overflow:hidden;}
.frame{box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(24,68,74,.12)!important;}
.titleHero img{height:min(69vh,700px)!important;object-fit:contain!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#faf6ed,#f0efe7)!important;}
.heroActions{padding:14px 18px 18px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(248,243,230,.94))!important;}
.heroFoot{padding:7px 18px 16px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,248,233,.95),rgba(255,247,238,.9))!important;}
.sectionPad{padding:22px!important}
.choiceGrid{gap:14px!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;}
.characterCard{border-radius:24px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffefb,#f5f7f4)!important;border-color:#d7e4dd!important;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(28,79,84,.08)!important}
.characterCard.selected{border-color:#66b9a4!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffefb,#e9fbf5)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(62,153,129,.22)!important}
.launchScreen{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(240,248,247,.96),rgba(250,244,232,.96));}
.launchHead,.launchContent,.launchFoot{position:relative;z-index:1}
.launchScreen:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(rgba(239,246,244,.7),rgba(239,246,244,.84)),url('data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///ywAAAAAAQABAAACAUwAOw==') center/cover no-repeat;filter:blur(6px) saturate(.85);transform:scale(1.05);}
.boardFrame{padding:10px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(239,246,244,.88),rgba(231,242,238,.88))!important;}
.mapViewport{height:clamp(450px,67vh,760px)!important;border-radius:28px!important;border:0!important;background:linear-gradient(rgba(237,245,243,.52),rgba(237,245,243,.62)),url('data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///ywAAAAAAQABAAACAUwAOw==') center/cover no-repeat!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.68),0 18px 38px rgba(20,57,59,.16)!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
.mapViewport:before{content:''!important;position:absolute;inset:0;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);background:linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 25%,transparent 25%,transparent 75%,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 75%),linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 25%,transparent 25%,transparent 75%,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 75%)!important;background-size:34px 34px,34px 34px!important;background-position:0 0,17px 17px!important;opacity:.85;}
#world{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important;border:10px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 38px,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 39px,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 40px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,transparent 38px,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 39px,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 40px),rgba(240,244,231,.78)!important;}
.areaColorKey{position:static!important;display:flex!important;justify-content:flex-end!important;gap:8px!important;padding:0 0 8px!important;background:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important}
.areaColorKey span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.85)!important;border:1px solid rgba(43,83,84,.12)!important;color:#365257!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.05)!important}
.gameControls{margin-top:10px!important;padding:12px 12px 10px!important;border-radius:24px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.84)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)!important;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(20,57,59,.12)!important}
.gameHud{padding:0 0 10px!important;gap:10px!important}
.scorePill{padding:9px 14px!important;border:1px solid rgba(43,83,84,.11)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9)!important;color:#2b4a50!important;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(20,57,59,.05)!important}
.gameToolbar{margin:0!important;gap:10px!important;align-items:flex-start!important}
.gameToolbar .hint{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#4a6b70}
.gameToolbar button,.areaNav button,.tinyButton{border:1px solid rgba(48,89,91,.16)!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f1f7f5)!important;color:#2f4c51!important;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(20,57,59,.06)!important;min-height:42px!important;padding:10px 14px!important}
.tinyButton{text-decoration:none;display:inline-grid;place-items:center}
.areaNav{padding:10px 0 2px!important;gap:8px!important;justify-content:flex-start!important}
.areaNav button{font-size:13px!important}
.mapBottom{display:none!important}
.station{width:150px!important;height:128px!important;border-radius:24px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.96),rgba(248,250,249,.92))!important;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92)!important;box-shadow:0 16px 26px rgba(18,54,56,.12)!important;gap:6px!important;padding-top:8px}
.station.done{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#effff8,#dbf8ea)!important;border-color:#b8eed0!important}
.station .number{top:-12px!important;left:-7px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffae64,#ff8e58)!important}
.station .doneMark{background:#44b88e!important}
.station .stIcon{font-size:42px!important}
.station .stIcon img,.equipment-photo{max-width:78px!important;max-height:58px!important;object-fit:contain!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
.station .stName{font-size:13px!important;font-weight:900!important;color:#35545a!important}
.roomTitle{font-size:20px!important;color:#314b52!important}
.roomFloor{font-size:14px!important;color:#436168!important}
.roomKind{font-size:11px!important}
.mapRegionNote,.entry,.mapDecoration,#player,.mascotCursor{display:none!important}
.modal{width:min(860px,100%)!important;max-height:min(92dvh,860px)!important;border-radius:28px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffefb,#f3f8f7)!important;box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(27,38,42,.35)!important}
.modalTop{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dff0ec,#f7ead3)!important;color:#2c4e54!important;padding:16px 18px 14px!important}
.modalTitle{font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,34px)!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1.2!important}
.modalBody{padding:20px 22px!important}
.challengeCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f4f9f7)!important;border:1px solid rgba(50,93,95,.1)!important;border-radius:24px!important;padding:18px 18px 16px!important;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(22,64,68,.07)!important;margin:0 0 14px!important}
.challengeQuestion{font-size:clamp(22px,3.2vw,34px)!important;line-height:1.35!important;color:#21434a!important;margin:0 0 12px!important}
.desc{font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.85!important;color:#35535a!important}
.options{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr))!important;gap:12px!important}
.option{border-radius:18px!important;padding:16px 14px!important;border:1px solid rgba(43,83,84,.12)!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f4faf7)!important;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(22,64,68,.08)!important;color:#2b4a50!important;font-weight:900!important;font-size:18px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
.bar{height:20px!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:#e5eeeb!important;overflow:hidden!important;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.bar>div{height:100%!important;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#51c3aa,#4e9cf7)!important}
.tapButton{width:110px!important;height:110px!important;border-radius:50%!important;border:0!important;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%,#fff8cf,#ffc960 62%,#f49b3f 100%)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(244,155,63,.3)!important;font-size:44px!important}
.stepProgress{font-size:18px!important;color:#45656b!important;margin:8px 0 12px!important}
.feedback{font-size:16px!important;color:#a45f40!important;font-weight:900;min-height:1.5em}
.findBugStage{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fbfa,#eef6f4);border-radius:24px;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(43,83,84,.1);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.findBugImage{display:block;width:min(100%,640px);margin:0 auto;max-height:340px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.08))}
.findBugCounter{text-align:center;font-size:18px;color:#365258;margin-top:10px;font-weight:900}
.bugSpot{position:absolute;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff3c4 10%,#ffb64d 48%,#ea7c2d 100%);color:#603100;font-size:23px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(234,124,45,.32);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:transform .12s,opacity .2s}
.bugSpot.found{opacity:.25;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.8);pointer-events:none}
.timingStage{padding:16px 6px 6px}
.timingBarWrap{position:relative;height:28px;border-radius:999px;background:#e0ece9;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08);margin:10px 0 12px}
.timingZone{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:42%;width:16%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8f0da,#62c79a);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(98,199,154,.38)}
.timingNeedle{position:absolute;top:-6px;bottom:-6px;width:14px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4e9cf7,#1f6dc1);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.75),0 6px 14px rgba(31,109,193,.25);transform:translateX(-50%)}
.timingActions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.timingStatus{font-size:18px;color:#305158;font-weight:900;text-align:center}
.cardCaptureOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:220}
.cardCaptureOverlay.visible{display:flex}
.cardCaptureStage{position:relative;width:min(86vw,760px);height:min(76vh,520px)}
.cardCaptureGlow{position:absolute;inset:8% 12%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,250,198,.95),rgba(255,206,84,.25) 42%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%);filter:blur(12px)}
.cardCaptureFront{position:absolute;left:50%;top:48%;width:min(44vw,280px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.24));transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1),left .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1),top .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1),width .7s}
.cardCaptureFront img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.cardCaptureLabel{position:absolute;left:50%;top:12%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.09);font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#325056;letter-spacing:.04em}
.cardCaptureFile{position:absolute;right:6%;bottom:7%;width:min(28vw,210px);height:min(36vw,160px);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffefc,#eef5f2);border:2px solid rgba(55,87,91,.14);box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12);overflow:hidden}
.cardCaptureFile:before{content:'STAR CARD FILE';position:absolute;left:14px;top:10px;font-size:15px;color:#35535a;font-weight:900}
.cardCaptureFile:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:14px;top:40px;border-radius:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(93,150,156,.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 48px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(93,150,156,.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 58px),rgba(255,255,255,.9);}
.cardCaptureOverlay.collected .cardCaptureFront{left:77%;top:66%;width:min(19vw,118px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-8deg)}
.cardCaptureOverlay.collected .cardCaptureLabel{opacity:.0;transition:opacity .35s}
.starAlbum{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.starAlbumBar,.starBottomBar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.starBinder{padding:18px;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f0f6f4,#f9fbfb);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7),0 10px 24px rgba(21,62,67,.08)}
.starSpread{display:block!important}
.starSleevePage{display:block!important}
.starPageLabel{margin-bottom:12px;font-size:16px;color:#33525a;font-weight:900}
.starPocketGrid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:12px!important}
.starPocket{min-height:176px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(50,93,95,.12);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#edf5f3);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(20,57,59,.08);padding:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cardLocked{color:#496a70;text-align:center;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.cardLocked:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:8px;border-radius:14px;border:2px dashed rgba(84,121,126,.24)}
.cardLocked .starLock{font-size:30px}
.cardUnlocked{padding:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#edf8f5)!important}
.cardUnlocked .starCardFace{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.cardUnlocked .starCardVisual{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%}
.cardUnlocked img{width:100%;max-height:150px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.cardUnlocked.justCollected{animation:justGet 1.1s ease both}
@keyframes justGet{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(255,211,92,0)}40%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(255,211,92,.38),0 0 26px rgba(255,206,84,.55)}100%{box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(20,57,59,.08)}}
.cardEmptyCharacter{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;color:#48676e;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdf8,#eef6f4)}
.cardEmptyCharacter img{width:78px;height:78px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
.starPreview.active{display:flex!important}
.starPreview{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;background:rgba(23,32,37,.58)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;z-index:260!important;padding:16px}
.starPreviewCard{width:min(480px,92vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffefc,#eff7f5);padding:20px;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.3);text-align:center}
.starPreviewCard img{width:min(320px,72vw);display:block;margin:12px auto;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.starPreviewCard h3{font-size:26px;margin:4px 0 10px;color:#21434a}
.starPreviewCard p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;color:#3a5960}
.starPreviewCard button{margin-top:10px;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 20px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#50c2aa,#2f8fc5);color:#fff;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 6px 0 rgba(34,107,134,.3)}
.endScene{display:grid;place-items:center;height:100%;padding:18px}
.endingPoster{position:relative;width:min(1180px,100%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(248,252,251,.92));border-radius:32px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(18,54,56,.14);overflow:hidden}
.endingPoster img{display:block;width:100%;height:min(66vh,720px);object-fit:cover}
.endingGlow{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%,rgba(255,246,195,.5),rgba(255,255,255,0) 42%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.02),rgba(255,255,255,.0) 45%,rgba(255,255,255,.6) 100%)}
.endingCaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:20px 22px 24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,62,75,0),rgba(14,62,75,.72) 24%,rgba(14,62,75,.92));color:#fff;text-align:center}
.endTitleFancy{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,58px);margin:0 0 8px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.endSubFancy{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,24px);margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.7}
.masterBadge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-size:17px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:12px}
.sparkleText{display:inline-block;animation:sparklePulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sparklePulse{50%{transform:scale(1.03);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(255,240,169,.65))}}
.endButtons{margin-top:12px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.endButtons .mainBtn,.endButtons .altBtn{min-width:180px}
.langBadge{font-size:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(44,78,84,.1);box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .screen.frame{min-height:auto}
  .choiceGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
  .mapViewport{height:58vh!important}
  .gameHud,.gameToolbar,.starAlbumBar,.starBottomBar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch!important}
  .boardActions,.scoreCluster{justify-content:flex-start!important}
  .starPocketGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  #app{width:100vw!important;padding:6px!important;}
  .screen.frame{border-radius:22px!important}
  .titleHero img{height:min(50vh,420px)!important}
  .mapViewport{height:52vh!important;border-radius:22px!important}
  .station{width:136px!important;height:118px!important}
  .starPocket{min-height:158px}
}


/* Ver.2.5 — one-screen full illustration cover with overlay navigation */
#home.screen.frame { display:none; position:relative; width:100%; height:calc(100dvh - 20px)!important; min-height:410px!important; overflow:hidden!important; isolation:isolate; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0e8d4,#daeeea); border-radius:24px!important; }
#home.screen.active { display:block!important; }
#home .titleHero { position:absolute!important; inset:0!important; width:100%;height:100%; min-height:0; padding:0; margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff4dc,#e6ece9)!important; cursor:pointer; }
#home .titleHero picture{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;}
#home .titleHero img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;background:transparent!important;user-select:none; -webkit-user-drag:none;}
#home .titleHero::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:30%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,46,60,0),rgba(12,45,56,.57));pointer-events:none;z-index:1;}
#home .coverVersion{position:absolute;right:clamp(12px,2vw,28px);top:clamp(12px,2vw,28px);z-index:4;display:inline-flex;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#1d5262;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.13);}
#home .heroActions{position:absolute!important;z-index:5;left:50%;bottom:clamp(10px,2vh,25px);transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(850px,96%);padding:12px!important;margin:0!important;display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;justify-content:center!important;align-items:center!important;gap:10px!important;background:rgba(9,46,59,.78)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(17px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(17px);border-radius:22px!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);box-shadow:0 14px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.25)!important;}
#home .coverTapText{flex:1 0 100%;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(12px,1.7vw,16px);letter-spacing:.04em;text-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
#home .mainBtn,#home .altBtn,#home .lunchGameLink{min-height:48px!important;padding:11px 18px!important;display:inline-flex!important;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:clamp(12px,1.35vw,15px)!important;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.32;text-decoration:none;border-radius:999px!important;position:relative;z-index:6;box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2)!important}
#home .mainBtn{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ffc163,#ff8b54)!important;color:#233e4a!important;text-shadow:none!important;}
#home .altBtn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95)!important;color:#28505b!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5)!important}
#home .lunchGameLink{background:rgba(210,241,238,.95)!important;color:#23545a!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important}
#home .lunchGameName{font-size:.86em;opacity:.82;letter-spacing:.01em}
#home button:focus-visible,#home .titleHero:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #ffd36e!important;outline-offset:-5px;}
@media(max-width:700px){
 #home.screen.frame{height:calc(100dvh - 12px)!important;border-radius:14px!important;}
 #home .heroActions{width:calc(100% - 16px);padding:10px 8px!important;gap:7px!important;bottom:8px;border-radius:16px!important}
 #home .coverTapText{font-size:12px!important;}
 #home .mainBtn,#home .altBtn{flex:1 0 calc(50% - 7px);min-height:42px!important;padding:9px 7px!important;font-size:13px!important;}
 #home .lunchGameLink{flex:1 0 100%;min-height:34px!important;padding:7px 5px!important;font-size:11px!important;}
 #home .coverVersion{font-size:11px;padding:6px 10px;}
 #home .titleHero::after{height:42%;}
}
@media(max-height:480px){
 #home.screen.frame{min-height:350px!important;}
 #home .heroActions{flex-wrap:nowrap!important;gap:7px!important;padding:7px!important;bottom:6px!important;}
 #home .coverTapText{display:none!important;}
 #home .mainBtn,#home .altBtn,#home .lunchGameLink{flex:1 1 auto!important;min-height:36px!important;padding:5px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;}
 #home .coverVersion{top:7px;right:8px;}
}


/* Fix inherited coverVersion bottom anchor; it must be a compact corner badge. */
#home .coverVersion { bottom:auto!important;left:auto!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:40px!important;align-self:flex-start!important;width:auto!important;max-width:90px!important; }

/* Keep all play commands inside a single visible screen, without hiding any control. */
#play.screen.active { display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important; }
#play.screen.frame { height:calc(100dvh - 20px)!important;min-height:350px!important; }
#play .mapViewport { flex:1 1 auto!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important; }
#play .gameControls { flex:0 0 auto!important;margin-top:7px!important;padding:7px 10px 6px!important; }
#play .gameHud{padding:0 0 4px!important;gap:6px!important;}
#play .gameToolbar{padding:0!important;gap:5px!important;}
#play .areaNav{padding:5px 0 0!important;gap:6px!important;}
#play .areaNav button,#play .gameToolbar button{min-height:34px!important;padding:5px 10px!important;}
#play .scorePill{padding:6px 10px!important;}
@media(min-width:901px){
 #play .gameHud{flex-direction:row!important;}
 #play .gameToolbar{flex-direction:row!important;}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
 #play .gameHud,#play .gameToolbar{flex-direction:row!important;align-items:center!important;}
 #play .gameToolbar>div{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
 #play .areaNav{flex-wrap:nowrap!important;overflow-x:auto!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;}
 #play .areaNav button{white-space:nowrap!important;flex-shrink:0!important;}
}
@media(max-height:500px){
 #play .gameControls{padding:3px 5px!important;margin-top:4px!important;}
 #play .gameHud{padding:0 0 3px!important;}
 #play .scorePill{font-size:10px!important;padding:3px 6px!important;}
 #play .gameToolbar .hint{display:none!important;}
 #play .gameToolbar button,#play .areaNav button{font-size:10px!important;min-height:26px!important;padding:3px 6px!important;}
 #play .gameToolbar>div{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;}
 #play .areaNav{padding:2px 0 0!important;}
}

/* FUJINOE KITCHEN ADVENTURE v2.4 — full-bleed kitchen illustration + glass controls */
:root{--ui-deep:#173a44;--glass-fill:rgba(245,255,253,.50);--glass-stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.68)}
body{background:#dcece8!important}
#app{width:100vw!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;}
#play.screen.frame{height:100dvh!important;min-height:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;gap:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
#play .mapViewport{flex:1 1 auto!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;width:100%!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;background-image:var(--fki325-shared-map-art)!important;background-position:center!important;background-size:cover!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;}
#play .mapViewport:before{display:none!important;}
#play #world{border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;background-image:var(--fki325-shared-map-art)!important;background-size:100% 100%!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-position:center!important;}
#play #world:before{display:none!important;}
#play .sanRoom{background:transparent!important;outline:0!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;}
#play .sanRoom:before,#play .sanRoom:after{display:none!important;}
#play .roomTitle{max-width:calc(100% - 20px)!important;left:8px!important;top:9px!important;font-size:23px!important;line-height:1.3!important;color:#123b43!important;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #ffffffd9!important;letter-spacing:.01em!important;padding:7px 12px!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:rgba(250,255,254,.69)!important;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(12,56,57,.10)!important;border-left:5px solid #75bca6!important;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)!important;}
#play .room-entry .roomTitle{border-left-color:#d6b590!important;}
#play .room-wash .roomTitle,#play .room-storage .roomTitle{border-left-color:#e49f7e!important;}
#play .room-cut .roomTitle,#play .room-cook .roomTitle{border-left-color:#74caa8!important;}
#play .room-clean .roomTitle{border-left-color:#b9a0db!important;}
#play .room-cupboard .roomTitle{border-left-color:#77aeca!important;}
#play .roomKind{display:block!important;background:transparent!important;padding:2px 0 0!important;box-shadow:none!important;margin:0!important;font-size:11px!important;color:#35616a!important;}
#play .roomFloor{display:none!important;}
#play .station{width:188px!important;height:162px!important;padding:0!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-end!important;gap:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:24px!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;overflow:visible!important;transition:transform .17s ease,filter .17s ease;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 11px rgba(3,38,42,.25));}
#play .station:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.09)!important;z-index:15!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 14px rgba(3,38,42,.3));}
#play .station .stIcon{width:100%!important;height:136px!important;min-height:0!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;overflow:visible!important;font-size:0!important;filter:none!important;}
#play .station .equipment-photo{display:block!important;width:170px!important;height:132px!important;max-width:170px!important;max-height:132px!important;object-fit:contain!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.20))!important;}
#play .station .equipment-art{display:block;width:166px!important;height:120px!important;max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;}
#play .station .stName{position:relative!important;display:block!important;white-space:nowrap!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:110px!important;min-height:28px!important;line-height:1.2!important;padding:6px 12px!important;font-size:17px!important;font-weight:900!important;color:#163e48!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85)!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:rgba(250,255,255,.85)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)!important;box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(10,54,59,.11)!important;}
#play .station .number{left:4px!important;top:0px!important;width:35px!important;height:35px!important;padding:0!important;min-width:35px!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:900!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.91)!important;color:#265465!important;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85)!important;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(5,37,43,.14)!important;}
#play .station.done .number{background:#d2f3e4!important;}
#play .station .doneMark{right:0px!important;top:0px!important;background:#2fab82!important;}
#play .station.done{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;}
#play .gameControls{flex:0 0 auto!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;max-height:unset!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:8px clamp(8px,2vw,28px) max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;margin:0!important;gap:7px!important;box-shadow:0 -10px 36px rgba(17,67,70,.14)!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(235,251,248,.56),rgba(229,248,245,.68))!important;backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(130%)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(130%)!important;}
#play .areaColorKey{display:none!important}
#play .gameHud{width:100%!important;flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;justify-content:center!important;align-items:center!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;gap:8px!important;}
#play .scoreCluster,#play .boardActions,#play .gameToolbar>div{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:6px!important;}
#play .gameToolbar{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;width:100%!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:6px!important;margin:0!important;}
#play .gameToolbar .hint{display:none!important;}
#play .scorePill{color:#19434b!important;font-size:12px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;font-weight:900!important;padding:6px 12px!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9)!important;box-shadow:0 3px 13px rgba(20,61,70,.08)!important;}
#play .gameControls button{cursor:pointer!important;color:#153f49!important;white-space:nowrap!important;word-break:keep-all!important;line-break:strict!important;overflow-wrap:normal!important;font-weight:900!important;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.84)!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.62),rgba(232,246,247,.28))!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.8),0 3px 9px rgba(16,64,73,.12)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(13px) saturate(130%)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(13px) saturate(130%)!important;text-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4)!important;transition:transform .16s,background .16s,box-shadow .16s!important;}
#play .gameControls button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:rgba(250,255,254,.85)!important;box-shadow:0 7px 17px rgba(16,64,73,.19)!important;}
#play .gameControls button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffbb65!important;outline-offset:2px!important;}
#play .gameControls .tinyButton,#play .gameToolbar button,#play .areaNav button{font-size:clamp(12px,.95vw,15px)!important;min-height:40px!important;padding:8px 15px!important;border-radius:999px!important;}
#play .areaNav{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;width:100%!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;gap:6px!important;overflow:visible!important;}
#play .spark{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 13px #ffe78c)}
/* The briefing screen uses dark high-contrast typography, not white-on-white */
#launch.launchScreen{color:#163c46!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#e9f5f2,#fff9ee)!important;}
#launch.launchScreen:before{opacity:.24!important;filter:blur(16px) saturate(.7)!important;background-image:var(--fki325-shared-map-art)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;transform:scale(1.08)!important;}
#launch.launchScreen:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(244,252,248,.72),rgba(255,250,239,.68));pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
#launch .launchHead,#launch .launchContent,#launch .launchFoot{position:relative;z-index:2;}
#launch .launchHead{padding:clamp(12px,2vh,27px) clamp(18px,4vw,56px) 4px!important;}
#launch .launchEyebrow{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px)!important;letter-spacing:.08em!important;color:#437d7d!important;text-shadow:none!important;}
#launch .launchHead h1{color:#183f49!important;font-weight:900!important;font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,50px)!important;line-height:1.34!important;letter-spacing:.01em!important;margin:6px 0!important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff8!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;}
#launch .launchHead p{color:#355f68!important;font-size:clamp(14px,1.18vw,19px)!important;font-weight:800!important;line-height:1.55!important;}
#launch .launchMedal{width:90px!important;height:90px!important;border:2px solid #ffffffbd!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff9e6,#ffe0a5)!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:0!important;color:#86592a!important;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(178,128,65,.2)!important;}
#launch .launchMedal strong{font-size:32px!important;line-height:1.05!important;}
#launch .launchMedal span{position:static!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.2!important;color:#86592a!important;}
#launch .launchContent{grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,35%) minmax(0,65%)!important;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:clamp(12px,2.2vw,36px)!important;padding:4px clamp(18px,3.8vw,56px) 10px!important;}
#launch .launchCaptain{min-height:0!important;}
#launch .launchCaptain img{max-height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 22px rgba(22,73,75,.18))!important;}
#launch .launchNamePlate{background:rgba(37,91,104,.87)!important;color:white!important;border:1px solid #ffffffa8!important;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)!important;}
#launch .launchMissions{justify-content:center!important;gap:10px!important;min-height:0!important;}
#launch .launchLabel{color:#3f7779!important;letter-spacing:.06em!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:900!important;}
#launch .launchLabel b{color:#234e5b!important;font-size:18px!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:14px!important;max-height:none!important;flex:0 1 auto!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles>div{min-height:clamp(108px,16vh,155px)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;border-left:5px solid #83c5b0!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.86),rgba(237,249,247,.73))!important;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(45,92,96,.11)!important;padding:16px 20px!important;gap:8px!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:flex-start!important;justify-content:center!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles>div:nth-child(1){border-left-color:#d6a86e!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles>div:nth-child(2){border-left-color:#e59b72!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles>div:nth-child(3){border-left-color:#73c59e!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles>div:nth-child(4){border-left-color:#aa9ad2!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles b{color:#153c46!important;font-size:clamp(21px,1.85vw,29px)!important;line-height:1.25!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}
#launch .launchMissionTiles small{color:#426c73!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.05vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.5!important;white-space:normal!important;font-weight:800!important;}
#launch .launchRules{gap:10px!important;color:#426972!important;font-size:clamp(12px,.98vw,15px)!important;line-height:1.5!important;font-weight:700!important;}
#launch .launchRules span:last-child{display:inline!important;}
#launch .launchFoot{border-top:1px solid rgba(31,84,94,.14)!important;background:rgba(234,247,243,.76)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)!important;padding:clamp(10px,1.3vh,18px) clamp(16px,3vw,44px) max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;}
#launch .introGhost{color:#2d5560!important;border:1px solid rgba(37,94,104,.29)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.65)!important;}
#launch .introPrimary{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ffd078,#ffb76c)!important;color:#173f49!important;font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,22px)!important;border-radius:999px!important;}
@media(max-width:900px){
 #launch .launchContent{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,38%) minmax(0,62%)!important;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)!important;}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles{gap:8px!important}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles>div{padding:12px!important;min-height:110px!important}
 #play .gameControls .tinyButton,#play .gameToolbar button,#play .areaNav button{min-height:34px!important;padding:6px 10px!important;font-size:12px!important}
 #play .gameControls{gap:4px!important;padding:5px 9px!important}
}
@media(max-width:640px) and (orientation:portrait){
 #launch .launchContent{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,36%) minmax(0,64%)!important;gap:3px!important;padding:2px 12px 5px!important;}
 #launch .launchHead h1{font-size:clamp(18px,5.4vw,25px)!important;}
 #launch .launchMedal{width:52px!important;height:52px!important;}
 #launch .launchMedal strong{font-size:22px!important}
 #launch .launchMedal span{font-size:9px!important}
 #launch .launchCaptain img{max-height:100%!important;}
 #launch .launchMissions{gap:4px!important;}
 #launch .launchLabel{font-size:11px!important;}
 #launch .launchLabel b{font-size:12px!important;}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles{gap:7px!important;}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles>div{padding:7px 10px!important;min-height:75px!important;gap:3px!important;border-radius:12px!important;}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles b{font-size:16px!important}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles small{font-size:10px!important}
 #launch .launchRules{font-size:9px!important;gap:3px!important;}
 #launch .launchRules span:last-child{display:none!important;}
 #launch .launchHead{padding:8px 14px 2px!important;}
 #launch .launchHead p{font-size:11px!important;}
 #play .scorePill{font-size:10px!important;padding:4px 8px!important}
 #play .gameControls .tinyButton,#play .gameToolbar button,#play .areaNav button{font-size:10px!important;min-height:29px!important;padding:5px 8px!important}
 #play .areaNav{display:none!important;}
}
@media(max-height:520px) and (orientation:landscape){
 #launch .launchHead{padding:5px 16px 0!important}
 #launch .launchHead h1{font-size:clamp(16px,3.3vw,24px)!important;margin:0!important;}
 #launch .launchHead p{font-size:10px!important}
 #launch .launchMedal{width:42px!important;height:42px!important}
 #launch .launchMedal strong{font-size:18px!important}
 #launch .launchMedal span{font-size:8px!important}
 #launch .launchContent{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,26%) minmax(0,74%)!important;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:9px!important;padding:0 12px!important;}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles{gap:5px!important}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles>div{min-height:55px!important;padding:5px 10px!important;gap:1px!important}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles b{font-size:14px!important}
 #launch .launchMissionTiles small{font-size:10px!important}
 #launch .launchRules{font-size:9px!important;gap:3px!important;}
 #launch .launchLabel{font-size:10px!important}
 #launch .launchLabel b{font-size:12px!important}
 #launch .launchFoot{padding:5px 12px!important;}
 #play .areaNav{display:none!important}
 #play .gameControls .tinyButton,#play .gameToolbar button{font-size:10px!important;min-height:27px!important;padding:4px 7px!important}
 #play .scorePill{font-size:10px!important;padding:3px 7px!important}
 #play .gameControls{gap:3px!important;padding:4px 6px!important}
}

#play .spark{font-size:13px!important;letter-spacing:0!important;width:55px!important;height:55px!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;color:#794d13!important;}
#play .spark.got{opacity:.4!important;}
#play .station .stIcon img{border-radius:0!important;}
#launch .launchMedal{flex-shrink:0!important;}

/* polished full-bleed overlay: the kitchen art continues under the transparent controls */
#play .mapViewport{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;flex:none!important;z-index:0!important;}
#play .gameControls{position:absolute!important;bottom:0!important;left:0!important;width:100%!important;z-index:30!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,252,249,.36),rgba(222,246,243,.66))!important;}
#play .station .stIcon img{background:transparent!important;}
#launch .launchNamePlate{font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,17px)!important;}
#launch .launchMedal strong{display:block!important;}
@media(max-width:640px){#play .gameControls{max-height:34vh!important;overflow-y:auto!important;}}

/* FUJINOE KITCHEN ADVENTURE Ver.2.5 — restore sectional map and single-sided page turns. */
:root{--v25kitchen:url('data:image/webp;base64,');--v25book:url('data:image/webp;base64,')}
/* The briefing has been removed from the navigation. */
#launch{display:none!important}
/* Reintroduce the original sanitary-zone colour map. The kitchen photograph is blurred beneath it. */
#play .mapViewport{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(232,249,246,.38),rgba(248,250,244,.38))!important;position:relative!important;isolation:isolate!important;}
#play .mapViewport::before{content:''!important;display:block!important;position:absolute!important;inset:-18px!important;background-image:var(--v25kitchen)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;filter:blur(14px)!important;opacity:.55!important;pointer-events:none!important;z-index:-1!important}
#play #world{background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important;isolation:isolate!important;}
#play #world::before{content:''!important;display:block!important;position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;background-image:var(--v25kitchen)!important;background-position:center!important;background-size:cover!important;filter:blur(18px) saturate(.78)!important;opacity:.35!important;pointer-events:none!important;z-index:-2!important}
#play .sanRoom{border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.90)!important;border-radius:22px!important;box-shadow:0 5px 13px rgba(25,69,70,.17),inset 0 1px 12px rgba(255,255,255,.26)!important;outline:0!important;z-index:1!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#play .sanRoom::before{content:''!important;display:block!important;position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.24),transparent 90%)!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#play .sanRoom::after{display:none!important}
#play .room-entry{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(248,235,206,.88),rgba(235,220,200,.81))!important}
#play .room-wash{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,215,174,.89),rgba(252,185,127,.79))!important}
#play .room-storage{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(251,205,225,.90),rgba(245,173,196,.78))!important}
#play .room-cut{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(210,245,225,.89),rgba(172,222,193,.79))!important}
#play .room-cook{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,243,219,.82),rgba(168,222,190,.75))!important}
#play .room-clean{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(226,216,251,.87),rgba(189,174,231,.79))!important}
#play .room-cupboard{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(203,239,250,.90),rgba(167,211,232,.80))!important}
#play .roomTitle{top:14px!important;left:12px!important;padding:7px 12px!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.60)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(43,89,91,.09)!important;color:#24464b!important;text-shadow:none!important;border-radius:12px!important;font-size:23px!important;line-height:1.3!important;max-width:calc(100% - 20px)!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;word-break:keep-all!important;}
#play .roomKind{display:block!important;color:#476365!important;font-size:10px!important;font-weight:800!important;margin-top:2px!important;white-space:normal!important}
#play .roomFloor{display:block!important;position:absolute!important;bottom:13px!important;left:12px!important;color:#536a68!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700!important;opacity:.80!important}
#play .station{z-index:4!important;}
#play .station .stName{white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;word-break:keep-all!important;min-width:0!important;text-align:center!important;line-height:1.18!important;padding:5px 9px!important;}
#play .gameControls{background:rgba(237,249,246,.74)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(15px)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(15px)!important;max-width:100vw!important;}
#play .gameControls button{white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;word-break:keep-all!important;line-height:1.2!important;text-align:center!important}
#play .areaNav{display:flex!important;gap:6px!important}
#play .areaNav button{flex:0 1 auto!important}
/* Long quiz answer choices must be wholly readable, not cropped by columns. */
#modalWrap .modal{max-height:min(94dvh,920px)!important;}
#modalWrap .modalBody{overflow:auto!important;overscroll-behavior:contain;}
#modalWrap .option{white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;word-break:normal!important;min-width:0!important;text-align:center!important;line-height:1.5!important;min-height:64px!important;padding:14px 13px!important;}
#modalWrap .options{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,240px),1fr))!important;align-items:stretch!important;}
#modalWrap .challengeCard{min-width:0!important;overflow:visible!important}
#modalWrap .challengeQuestion{white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;word-break:normal!important;}
#modalWrap .modalTitle{overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;white-space:normal!important;line-height:1.3!important;}
/* The book uses the user's official blue/gold blank book art, with cards placed only on one page at a time. */
#modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:min(1370px,98vw)!important;height:min(96dvh,950px)!important;max-height:96dvh!important;}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalTop{padding:10px 18px!important;min-height:56px!important;flex-shrink:0!important;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#d5eaf8,#f6e6ba)!important;}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalTitle{color:#164379!important;font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,28px)!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{padding:clamp(8px,1vh,13px)!important;overflow:hidden!important;display:flex!important;min-height:0!important;flex:1!important;}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-album{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;}
.v25-book{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;aspect-ratio:3/2;background-image:var(--v25book);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:100% 100%;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(27,69,112,.16);transition:opacity .22s,transform .22s;}
.v25-book.v25-turning{opacity:.64;transform:perspective(900px) rotateY(-7deg) scale(.99)}
.v25-book-left{position:absolute;left:9%;top:20%;width:33%;height:65%;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#16456e;gap:8px;}
.v25-book-kicker{font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,18px);letter-spacing:.12em;margin:0;font-weight:900;color:#597c97}
.v25-book-left h3{font-size:clamp(18px,2.2vw,37px);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.015em;margin:4px 0;color:#174c80;word-break:keep-all}
.v25-book-description{font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,18px);line-height:1.7;margin:0;color:#4f7188;font-weight:800}
.v25-book-counter{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;margin-top:10px}
.v25-book-counter strong{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,49px);line-height:1;color:#1264b1;text-shadow:0 2px #fff}
.v25-book-counter small{font-size:.55em}
.v25-book-counter span{letter-spacing:.11em;font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,16px);font-weight:900;color:#6288a3}
.v25-book-pageno{margin:0;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,16px);color:#6d89a1;font-weight:900}
.v25-book-right{position:absolute;left:55%;top:16%;width:36%;height:69%;display:grid;place-items:center;}
.v25-page-cards{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(6px,1.2vw,16px);}
.v25-pocket{appearance:none;border:1.5px solid rgba(113,160,188,.29);padding:clamp(4px,.55vw,9px);border-radius:clamp(9px,1vw,17px);background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(255,255,255,.65),rgba(233,243,245,.72));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.38),0 6px 13px rgba(45,81,105,.09);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;}
.v25-pocket img{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;max-height:100%!important;object-fit:contain;border-radius:7px;}
.v25-collected{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.v25-collected:hover{transform:scale(1.035);box-shadow:0 10px 23px rgba(34,90,130,.2)}
.v25-collected:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #00a0ff;outline-offset:2px}
.v25-locked,.v25-empty{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;color:#6e8797;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,18px);font-weight:900;text-align:center;border:2px dashed rgba(109,152,184,.43)}
.v25-locked b{color:#4d7695}
.v25-complete-burst{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%;text-align:center;gap:8px;position:relative;}
.v25-complete-burst::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,231,98,.5) 0,rgba(255,231,98,.18) 34%,transparent 68%);pointer-events:none;animation:v25shine 2.7s infinite alternate}
.v25-complete-tag{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#ffc644,#fff9b7,#f2a620);box-shadow:0 6px 21px rgba(210,155,40,.27);border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:999px;padding:7px clamp(10px,1.3vw,22px);font-size:clamp(15px,1.9vw,29px);color:#154e8e;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.07em;z-index:1}
.v25-complete-burst h3{font-size:clamp(18px,2.1vw,36px);color:#1a4d89;line-height:1.25;text-shadow:0 2px #fff;font-weight:1000;word-break:keep-all;margin:0;z-index:1}
.v25-complete-burst p{font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,17px);line-height:1.5;margin:0;color:#2c6488;z-index:1}
.v25-character-group{display:flex;position:relative;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;flex:1;min-height:0;margin:0;z-index:1;}
.v25-character-group img{height:90%;max-width:29%;width:auto;object-fit:contain;margin-inline:-2%;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 7px rgba(16,57,85,.18));animation:v25float 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v25-character-group img:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.3s}.v25-character-group img:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.6s}.v25-character-group img:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.9s}
@keyframes v25float{to{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
@keyframes v25shine{to{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1.06)}}
.v25-book-navigation{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(6px,1vw,16px);flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0;min-height:45px;}
.v25-book-navigation>button{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#e0f2ff,#f9eed4);border:1.5px solid #b1cce3;border-radius:999px;color:#184e82;font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,18px);padding:8px clamp(15px,2vw,28px);font-weight:900;min-height:39px;cursor:pointer;}
.v25-page-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.v25-page-tabs button{width:39px;height:39px;border-radius:50%;font-size:16px;border:1.5px solid #9ac1dd;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#1d5e97;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;}
.v25-page-tabs button.selected{background:#1877b9;color:#fff;border-color:#1877b9;}
.v25-book-navigation button:disabled{opacity:.34!important;cursor:default!important;}
#v25-page-index{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,17px);color:#285577;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v25-book-hint{margin:0;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(10px,.95vw,13px);color:#355f7b;line-height:1.35;flex:0 0 auto}
.v25-star-preview.active{display:flex!important}
.v25-star-preview{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(12,26,40,.74);backdrop-filter:blur(9px);z-index:500;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;}
.v25-detail-card{background:#fff;border-radius:25px;width:min(520px,94vw);max-height:94dvh;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:16px;gap:7px;box-shadow:0 25px 65px rgba(0,0,0,.33)}
.v25-detail-card>.originalStarCard{display:block;width:auto;max-width:min(350px,75vw);height:min(63dvh,550px);object-fit:contain;box-shadow:0 12px 27px rgba(11,42,78,.2);border-radius:12px;}
.v25-detail-card>p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#416074;margin:0}
.v25-detail-card>h3{font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;color:#155b91;margin:0}
.v25-detail-card>button{background:#176faf;color:white;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;border:0;min-height:42px;padding:9px 24px;cursor:pointer;}
@media(max-width:700px){
 #modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:100vw!important;height:min(95dvh,900px)!important;max-height:none!important;border-radius:14px!important}
 #modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{padding:6px!important}
 .v25-book{background-size:200% 100%!important;background-position:right center!important;min-height:min(65dvh,550px);border-radius:10px!important}
 .v25-book-left{display:none!important}
 .v25-book-right{left:11%!important;top:16%!important;width:78%!important;height:68%!important;}
 .v25-page-cards{gap:clamp(6px,2vw,12px)!important}
 .v25-pocket{padding:4px!important;border-radius:10px!important}
 .v25-complete-tag{font-size:clamp(15px,4.4vw,24px)!important}
 .v25-complete-burst h3{font-size:clamp(18px,5vw,31px)!important}
 .v25-complete-burst p{font-size:clamp(12px,3.3vw,18px)!important}
 .v25-book-navigation{gap:5px!important}
 .v25-book-navigation>button{min-width:55px!important;padding:8px 10px!important}
 .v25-page-tabs button{width:33px!important;height:33px!important;font-size:14px!important}
 .v25-book-hint{font-size:11px!important}
 #play .gameControls{padding:6px!important}
 #play .gameControls button{font-size:11px!important;padding:5px 7px!important;min-height:30px!important}
}
@media(max-height:500px) and (orientation:landscape){
 #modalWrap.starMode .modal{height:99dvh!important;max-height:99dvh!important}
 #modalWrap.starMode .modalTop{min-height:38px!important;padding:4px 12px!important}
 .v25-book-navigation{min-height:30px!important}
 .v25-book-navigation button{padding:4px 12px!important;min-height:29px!important}
 .v25-page-tabs button{width:28px!important;height:28px!important}
 .v25-book-hint{display:none!important}
}
/* Fix: keep four original portrait cards inside the right-page printable area. */
.v25-book-right{display:block!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.v25-page-cards{display:grid!important;height:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;overflow:hidden!important;align-items:stretch!important}
.v25-pocket{min-height:0!important;min-width:0!important;max-height:100%!important;height:100%!important;align-self:stretch!important;justify-self:stretch!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.v25-pocket .originalStarCard{width:auto!important;max-width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;object-fit:contain!important;margin:auto!important}
.v25-congrats{display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;overflow:visible!important}
#cardCaptureOverlay .cardCaptureFile{background-image:var(--v25book)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;border:2px solid rgba(255,218,100,.8)!important}
#cardCaptureOverlay .cardCaptureFile::before,#cardCaptureOverlay .cardCaptureFile::after{display:none!important}
/* At short heights keep the last row of area controls above the device safe edge. */
#play .areaNav{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;gap:5px!important;line-height:1!important}
#play .areaNav button{min-height:26px!important;height:26px!important;padding:3px 10px!important;line-height:1.1!important;font-size:11px!important}
@media(max-width:700px), (max-height:500px){#play .gameControls{gap:3px!important;padding-bottom:max(3px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important}}
/* Small screens: preserve all four area shortcuts in a floating strip immediately above the lower toolbar. */
@media (max-width:700px), (max-height:500px){
 #play .gameControls{position:relative!important}
 #play .areaNav{position:absolute!important;left:4px!important;right:4px!important;bottom:calc(100% + 3px)!important;display:flex!important;justify-content:center!important;align-items:center!important;z-index:10!important;transform:none!important;padding:3px!important;margin:0!important;background:rgba(236,249,245,.74)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)!important;border-radius:999px!important;box-shadow:0 3px 11px rgba(20,61,70,.1)!important}
}
@media (max-width:700px), (max-height:500px){#play .gameControls{position:absolute!important;bottom:0!important;left:0!important;right:0!important}}
@media (max-width:700px), (max-height:500px){#play .gameControls{bottom:14px!important}}

/* Ver.2.8 — custom responsive full-screen game experience; original graphics and cards retained */
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden!important}
body{margin:0!important;background:#dfede9!important}
#app{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important}
body>header,#app>header{display:none!important}
#play.active,#end.active{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;width:100vw!important;height:100dvh!important;max-height:100dvh!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#f1f6f3!important;animation:none!important;z-index:10!important}
#play>.mapViewport,#play>.gameControls{display:none!important}
#play .v26-stage{display:flex;position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;padding:clamp(7px,.7vw,13px) clamp(8px,1.8vw,30px) clamp(7px,.7vw,14px);gap:clamp(5px,.75vh,10px);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(227,241,240,.68),rgba(232,242,238,.4))}
#play .v26-stage::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-24px;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background-image:var(--v26-kitchen);background-position:center;background-size:cover;filter:blur(10px) saturate(.76);opacity:.79;transform:scale(1.03)}
.v26-top{display:flex;flex:0 0 auto;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:clamp(8px,2vw,28px);min-height:clamp(67px,10dvh,106px);padding:3px 6px}
.v26-brand{position:relative;isolation:isolate;min-width:0;flex:0 1 auto;padding:6px 14px 7px 9px;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:white;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 3px rgba(17,51,67,.19));line-height:1.08;overflow:visible}
.v26-brand-lead{font-size:clamp(11px,1.35vw,19px);font-weight:1000;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.04em;text-shadow:-2px -2px 0 #ee5eab,2px -2px 0 #ee5eab,-2px 2px 0 #ee5eab,2px 2px 0 #ee5eab,0 3px 4px rgba(111,23,85,.24);margin:0 0 2px 6px;width:max-content;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(246,97,164,.88),rgba(241,125,175,.58))}
.v26-brand-main{display:block;font-size:clamp(17px,2.75vw,40px);font-weight:1000;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:1.25;color:#0071d0;-webkit-text-stroke:clamp(.8px,.13vw,2px) #fff;text-shadow:1px 2px 0 #f6fcff,2px 3px 0 #1562ae,3px 5px 3px rgba(7,44,93,.3),0 0 15px rgba(251,255,255,.92)}
.v26-version{position:absolute;right:1px;bottom:0;font-size:clamp(8px,.7vw,11px);color:#42667b;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 5px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:900}
.v26-tabs{display:flex;flex:1 1 auto;max-width:640px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:clamp(5px,.7vw,11px);min-width:0}
.v26-tabs button{border:2px solid rgba(252,255,255,.93);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(217,231,240,.84));border-radius:999px;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 3px #fff,0 5px 0 rgba(83,107,123,.23),0 6px 14px rgba(17,60,74,.15);color:#194365;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(12px,1.42vw,21px);padding:clamp(7px,.8vw,12px) clamp(9px,1.5vw,26px);flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;touch-action:manipulation}
.v26-tabs button.current,.v26-tabs button:focus-visible{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#02a7ff,#1e56cf);color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.25);border-color:white;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(43,211,252,.45),0 4px 12px rgba(27,96,194,.25)}
.v26-board-scroller{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(138,176,179,.7) transparent;border-radius:clamp(18px,2.2vw,35px);border:clamp(4px,.48vw,8px) double rgba(255,255,255,.96);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(124,219,234,.48),inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.45),0 16px 36px rgba(24,61,78,.24);overscroll-behavior-x:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.v26-room-grid{display:grid;width:100%;height:100%;min-width:0;min-height:0;grid-template-columns:15.5% 19% 15% 16.5% 34%;grid-template-rows:46% 54%;gap:0;overflow:hidden;padding:3px;isolation:isolate}
.v26-room{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;isolation:isolate;border:clamp(2px,.30vw,5px) solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);border-radius:clamp(12px,1.7vw,27px);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 11px rgba(255,255,255,.74),inset 0 -12px 22px rgba(255,255,255,.17),0 1px 14px rgba(32,68,79,.15);padding:clamp(7px,.8vw,14px);gap:3px}
.v26-room::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-6px;z-index:-1;background-image:var(--v26-kitchen);background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:.1;filter:blur(6px)}
.v26-front{grid-area:1/1/2/2;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,244,206,.94),rgba(255,234,193,.90))}
.v26-prep{grid-area:1/2/2/3;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,222,182,.94),rgba(253,193,153,.85))}
.v26-storage{grid-area:1/3/2/4;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,214,228,.97),rgba(239,176,204,.86))}
.v26-cut{grid-area:1/4/2/5;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(224,251,223,.97),rgba(172,229,183,.90))}
.v26-cook{grid-area:1/5/3/6;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(207,247,220,.96),rgba(168,221,190,.87))}
.v26-wash{grid-area:2/1/3/3;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(232,218,255,.95),rgba(203,179,248,.90))}
.v26-clean{grid-area:2/3/3/5;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(219,245,255,.96),rgba(158,211,245,.88))}
.v26-room-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;flex:0 0 auto;max-width:100%;min-height:0;position:relative;z-index:1;gap:3px}
.v26-room-head h2{background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);color:#283e44;display:block;width:max-content;max-width:100%;border:1.5px solid #fff;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 5px 10px rgba(33,66,73,.13);padding:clamp(4px,.55vw,10px) clamp(9px,.86vw,15px);line-height:1.18;margin:0;font-size:clamp(13px,1.6vw,26px);font-weight:1000;white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.v26-room-head small{font-size:clamp(9px,.69vw,12px);font-weight:850;color:#31535c;background:none!important;padding-left:clamp(6px,.8vw,12px);white-space:normal;line-height:1.25;max-width:100%;text-shadow:0 1px #fff}
.v26-devices{display:flex;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;min-width:0;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:clamp(3px,.5vw,10px);position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 2px 6px}
.v26-device{position:relative;display:flex;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;min-height:0;height:100%;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;padding:clamp(2px,.5vw,8px);background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:#153d4e;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .16s,filter .16s}
.v26-device::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:8% 4% 10%;border-radius:18px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 62%,rgba(255,255,255,.42),transparent 67%);z-index:-1}
.v26-device:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);filter:brightness(1.06)}
.v26-device:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #318ce0;outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:12px}
.v26-device img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:calc(100% - clamp(35px,3.2vw,62px));flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 9px rgba(39,59,67,.26));pointer-events:none}
.v26-device strong{display:block;position:relative;flex:0 0 auto;max-width:100%;font-size:clamp(11px,1.06vw,18px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.015em;padding:clamp(4px,.35vw,7px) clamp(5px,.75vw,12px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border:1.5px solid #fff;border-radius:99px;box-shadow:0 4px 9px rgba(17,55,75,.1);white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:keep-all;text-align:center}
.v26-number,.v26-check{position:absolute;display:grid;place-items:center;top:0;width:clamp(22px,2.1vw,32px);height:clamp(22px,2.1vw,32px);z-index:2;border-radius:50%;background:#eafff6;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#20657a;font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,15px);font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(39,74,86,.1)}
.v26-number{left:0}.v26-check{right:0;background:#31b18d;color:white;font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,19px)}
.v26-cook .v26-devices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px;justify-items:stretch;align-items:stretch;padding:0 3px 5px}
.v26-cook .v26-device img{max-height:calc(100% - 31px)}
.v26-wash .v26-device,.v26-clean .v26-device{max-width:64%;margin:0 auto}
.v26-wash .v26-device img,.v26-clean .v26-device img{max-height:calc(100% - 40px)}
.v26-secret{position:absolute;bottom:clamp(9px,1vw,16px);right:clamp(9px,1vw,16px);z-index:3;width:clamp(38px,4vw,62px);height:clamp(38px,4vw,62px);display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.96);background:radial-gradient(circle at 42% 35%,#fffbe0 0,#ffe8a4 39%,#ffc94e 70%,#eba42e 100%);color:#975819;font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,15px);font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 0 12px #fff4a8,0 0 25px rgba(255,190,52,.7),0 5px 12px rgba(128,93,34,.25);animation:v26SecretPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;touch-action:manipulation}
.v26-secret.found{display:none!important}
@keyframes v26SecretPulse{50%{filter:brightness(1.16);box-shadow:0 0 26px #ffeb9f,0 0 34px rgba(255,194,48,.7);transform:scale(1.08)}}
.v26-bottom{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(4px,.5vw,8px);height:clamp(55px,8dvh,77px);min-height:50px;max-width:100%;padding:8px clamp(7px,1vw,18px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.91);border-radius:clamp(14px,1.9vw,26px);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(245,252,254,.77),rgba(211,225,232,.66))!important;backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(130%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(130%);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.95),0 9px 20px rgba(41,78,91,.19);overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scrollbar-width:thin;white-space:nowrap}
.v26-stats,.v26-menu-buttons{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(3px,.5vw,9px);flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap}
.v26-stats{padding-right:clamp(7px,.9vw,17px);margin-right:clamp(4px,.7vw,13px);border-right:1.5px solid rgba(100,130,150,.45)}
.v26-stats span,.v26-menu-buttons button{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.96);background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(255,255,255,.91),rgba(221,232,243,.84));box-shadow:inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.92),0 3px 2px rgba(96,119,134,.28),0 5px 9px rgba(23,57,75,.13);font-size:clamp(10px,.9vw,15px);font-weight:950;color:#23465f;min-height:clamp(34px,4vh,48px);padding:clamp(4px,.45vw,9px) clamp(8px,.85vw,15px);white-space:nowrap;touch-action:manipulation}
.v26-stats span b{color:#bf771a;font-size:1.14em}
.v26-menu-buttons button:hover{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#ccefff);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v26-menu-buttons button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #309de8;outline-offset:0}
.v26-menu-buttons .v26-reset{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffe7ee,#f5aec5);color:#9b294c}
.v26-board-scroller.enlarged .v26-room-grid{min-width:1480px!important;transition:min-width .2s ease}
#v26-confetti,.v26-ending-particles{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:55;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#v26-confetti i,.v26-ending-particles i{position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:-25px;display:block;width:clamp(5px,.6vw,10px);height:clamp(10px,1vw,18px);border-radius:2px;background:var(--c);animation:v26Fall var(--d) var(--delay) ease-in both;transform:rotate(0)}
@keyframes v26Fall{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)}8%{opacity:1}92%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(110dvh) rotate(780deg)}}
#end.active{background:#193f48!important;isolation:isolate}
#end .v26-end-photo{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#end .v26-end-photo::before{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:0;inset:-35px;background-image:var(--v26-ending);background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:blur(13px) brightness(.74)}
#end .v26-ending-art{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.19))}
#end .v26-end-overlay{position:absolute;z-index:2;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(6px,1.1vh,14px);padding:clamp(14px,2.6vh,28px) 12px max(clamp(16px,3vh,38px),env(safe-area-inset-bottom));text-align:center;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,47,59,0),rgba(13,56,70,.7) 18%,rgba(10,50,63,.93));text-shadow:0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
#end .v26-end-badge{font-size:clamp(14px,1.75vw,25px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff8c4;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(255,212,86,.19),rgba(255,240,189,.24));border:1px solid rgba(255,239,176,.65);border-radius:999px;padding:6px clamp(16px,3vw,40px);box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(255,234,124,.35);animation:v26EndGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v26EndGlow{to{box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,235,130,.65);filter:brightness(1.1)}}
#end .v26-end-overlay h1{font-size:clamp(29px,5.6vw,81px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:.03em;margin:0;color:#fff;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:keep-all}
#end .v26-end-overlay p{font-size:clamp(13px,1.6vw,23px);font-weight:850;line-height:1.38;margin:0;word-break:keep-all}
#end .v26-end-stats,#end .v26-end-buttons{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:clamp(6px,.9vw,16px);flex-wrap:wrap}
#end .v26-end-stats span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.89);border:1px solid #fff;color:#264b61;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,15px);font-weight:900;border-radius:100px;padding:6px 13px;text-shadow:none}
#end .v26-end-buttons button{border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);border-radius:100px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(17,51,66,.26);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffef7,#e9f4f7);color:#255172;padding:clamp(8px,1vh,14px) clamp(13px,1.6vw,25px);font-size:clamp(12px,1.17vw,19px);font-weight:950;min-height:41px;white-space:nowrap;touch-action:manipulation}
#end .v26-end-buttons button#v26-end-cards{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffe59c,#ffae5a);color:#794014}
#end .v26-end-buttons button.v26-danger,.v26-danger{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffb8ce,#ec648c);color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff2f6;border-radius:100px;padding:9px 19px;font-weight:950;min-height:42px;cursor:pointer}
.v26-reset-confirm{max-width:650px;margin:14px auto;text-align:center}
.v26-reset-confirm h2{color:#864159;font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);line-height:1.3}
.v26-reset-confirm p{color:#35586a;font-size:clamp(15px,1.5vw,19px);line-height:1.7}
.v26-reset-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:10px}
/* Quiz and modal text: preserve all text, even long answers. */
#modalWrap .modal{max-width:min(920px,calc(100vw - 16px))!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 16px)!important;overflow:hidden!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;min-height:0!important}
#modalWrap .modalTop{flex:0 0 auto;gap:8px!important;min-height:0!important;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#dbf1ed,#f6e5be)!important;color:#284e60!important}
#modalWrap .modalTitle{font-size:clamp(16px,2.8vw,32px)!important;color:#274a57!important;white-space:normal!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;line-height:1.25!important}
#modalWrap .modalBody{min-height:0!important;overflow:auto!important;scrollbar-width:thin!important;overscroll-behavior:contain!important;padding:clamp(10px,1.7vw,22px)!important}
#modalWrap .modalFooter{flex:0 0 auto!important}
#modalWrap .challengeQuestion{font-size:clamp(18px,2.3vw,28px)!important;line-height:1.45!important;white-space:normal!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
#modalWrap .options{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,225px),1fr))!important;gap:11px!important}
#modalWrap .option{min-width:0!important;min-height:70px!important;height:auto!important;white-space:normal!important;line-height:1.4!important;overflow:visible!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;padding:12px 13px!important;font-size:clamp(14px,1.4vw,20px)!important;text-align:center!important}
#modalWrap .desc,#modalWrap .hint{font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.6!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
#modalWrap .modalActions{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#modalWrap .modalActions button{white-space:normal!important;min-height:44px!important}
/* Bigger card binder on completion, readable headings */
#modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:min(1180px,98vw)!important;max-width:min(1180px,98vw)!important;height:min(95dvh,850px)!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{overflow:hidden!important;flex:1 1 auto!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;gap:6px!important;padding:7px 12px!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-album{flex:1 1 auto!important;height:100%!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-book{min-height:0!important;background-size:200% 100%!important;flex:1 1 auto!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-complete-tag{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#ffe57d,#fff8cb,#ffc66b);text-shadow:none;color:#164675;font-size:clamp(13px,1.7vw,29px)!important;line-height:1.2!important;white-space:normal!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-complete-burst h3{color:#134a88;font-size:clamp(18px,2.8vw,42px)!important;line-height:1.25!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-character-group img{max-width:27%;height:90%;object-fit:contain}
#modalWrap .originalStarCard{object-fit:contain!important}
.v26-game-feedback{min-height:20px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,18px);color:#b25d36;font-weight:950;text-align:center;line-height:1.5}
.v26-mini{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;min-height:0;text-align:center}
.v26-mini-label{font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,15px);letter-spacing:.1em;color:#318296;font-weight:950}
.v26-mini h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.5vw,34px);color:#235b6a;font-weight:1000;line-height:1.28;margin:0;word-break:keep-all}
.v26-mini p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.35vw,17px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.5;color:#3c6070;margin:0;word-break:keep-all}
.v26-mini-stats{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:8px;color:#296070;font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,20px);font-weight:950}
.v26-mini-stats b{font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,34px);color:#e7852f;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v26-mini-meter{height:22px;border-radius:99px;background:#deedf0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #c6d9e3;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px rgba(35,88,99,.15)}
.v26-mini-meter i{display:block;width:0%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#75d4ee,#43a5ea,#5cceaa);border-radius:99px;transition:width .1s}
.v26-game-main{width:100%;max-width:400px;display:block;margin:7px auto;border:2px solid white;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffc866,#f59a45);color:#264c52;font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,29px);font-weight:1000;min-height:60px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #c98c47;touch-action:manipulation}
.v26-game-main[hidden],.v26-scrub[hidden]{display:none!important}
.v26-mini-message{font-weight:950!important;color:#26728b!important;min-height:24px}
.v26-wash-layout,.v26-rapid-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:clamp(9px,2vw,24px);align-items:center;min-width:0;min-height:0;margin:7px 0}
.v26-wash-work,.v26-rapid-layout>div{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.v26-wash-visual{height:clamp(170px,28vh,300px);position:relative;border-radius:20px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#f9ffff,#e4f6f6);border:2px solid rgba(132,189,197,.44);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 9px #fff;overflow:hidden}
.v26-wash-visual>img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 12px #2e60743d)}
.v26-wash-bubbles{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.v26-wash-bubbles i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);background:radial-gradient(circle at 33% 25%,#fff,rgba(165,237,255,.45) 55%,rgba(94,184,238,.12));box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(62,146,210,.22);animation:v26Bubble 2.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v26Bubble{to{transform:translate(7px,-30px);opacity:.5}}
.v26-scrub{border:3px solid #d0f0fd;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#b6eefb,#effcff);color:#1b6c82;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #94c3d2;border-radius:24px;min-height:clamp(85px,14vh,125px);width:100%;font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,22px);font-weight:1000;padding:10px;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;white-space:normal;line-height:1.4}
.v26-bug-stats{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:clamp(15px,1.45vw,21px);color:#237a6f;font-weight:1000}
.v26-bug-tray{height:clamp(190px,36vh,340px);border-radius:27px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#effdf2 0,#e3f9dd 40%,#7ec89b 70%,#b7d4b9 71%,#dde8e5 77%,#b9c7ca 80%,#edf6f7 85%);border:10px solid #d6e8e5;box-shadow:inset 0 8px 20px rgba(25,78,64,.16),0 10px 20px rgba(24,70,74,.14);cursor:crosshair}
.v26-tray-label{position:absolute;top:7px;left:12px;background:#ffffffc8;border:1px solid #fff;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,16px);font-weight:950;color:#357e5e;z-index:3}
.v26-leaf{position:absolute;width:clamp(35px,6.4vw,90px);height:clamp(37px,7.2vw,95px);border-radius:70% 20% 62% 27%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 26% 18%,#a9ec80,#4eaa54 53%,#287e49 100%);border:1px solid rgba(61,129,49,.4);box-shadow:inset 4px 3px 5px rgba(255,255,255,.22),0 3px 5px rgba(23,91,38,.12)}
.v26-leaf::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:16%;right:20%;top:48%;height:2px;background:rgba(212,255,160,.55);transform:rotate(-29deg)}
.v26-the-bug{position:absolute;z-index:5;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:clamp(30px,4vw,57px);height:clamp(30px,4vw,57px);border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;display:grid;place-items:center;touch-action:manipulation;animation:v26BugWiggle .7s infinite alternate}
@keyframes v26BugWiggle{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(8deg) scale(1.08)}}
.v26-bug-body{position:relative;width:48%;height:65%;display:block;border:2px solid #183524;border-radius:48%;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#223729,#13251d);box-shadow:inset -4px 0 #3c5c42,0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.v26-bug-body::before,.v26-bug-body::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:-40%;width:172%;height:1.6px;background:#203b2a}
.v26-bug-body::before{top:28%;transform:rotate(25deg)}.v26-bug-body::after{top:67%;transform:rotate(-25deg)}
.v26-rapid-layout>img{width:100%;height:clamp(165px,26vh,270px);object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 12px rgba(20,63,72,.22))}
