@media(max-width:1100px){.v26-room-grid{min-width:900px;}.v26-brand-main{font-size:clamp(17px,2.4vw,27px)}.v26-tabs button{font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,17px)}.v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,15px)}}
@media(max-width:720px){.v26-top{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;justify-content:center;min-height:0;padding:0 3px}.v26-brand{padding:0 5px 0;flex:0 0 auto}.v26-brand-main{font-size:clamp(19px,4.8vw,29px)}.v26-brand-lead{font-size:12px;padding:2px 5px}.v26-version{bottom:0}.v26-tabs{max-width:100%;width:100%;flex:1 1 100%;justify-content:stretch;gap:4px}.v26-tabs button{font-size:clamp(11px,2.9vw,16px);padding:5px 7px}.v26-bottom{height:60px;min-height:60px;gap:4px;padding:4px 6px}.v26-stats span,.v26-menu-buttons button{font-size:12px;min-height:39px;padding:7px 10px}.v26-end-overlay{padding:12px 8px 16px}.v26-mini h2{font-size:22px}.v26-mini p{font-size:13px}.v26-wash-layout,.v26-rapid-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}.v26-wash-visual{height:155px}.v26-bug-tray{height:190px}}
@media(orientation:portrait) and (max-width:720px){#play .v26-stage{padding:6px 5px 5px}.v26-room-grid{min-width:890px}.v26-top{height:auto}.v26-tabs{min-height:33px}.v26-board-scroller{min-height:0}.v26-room-head h2{font-size:16px}.v26-device strong{font-size:12px}.v26-device img{max-height:calc(100% - 37px)}#end .v26-end-overlay{gap:8px;padding-bottom:max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}#end .v26-end-overlay h1{font-size:clamp(29px,8vw,46px)}#end .v26-end-overlay p{font-size:13px}#end .v26-end-buttons button{padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px}.v26-wash-layout,.v26-rapid-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v26-wash-visual{height:130px}.v26-rapid-layout>img{height:145px}.v26-wash-work{gap:6px}.v26-scrub{min-height:68px}.v26-mini p{line-height:1.38}.v26-bug-tray{height:clamp(175px,30vh,250px)}}
@media (max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape){.v26-top{min-height:50px}.v26-brand-lead{font-size:10px}.v26-brand-main{font-size:clamp(18px,2.5vw,28px)}.v26-tabs button{padding:5px 6px}.v26-room-head h2{font-size:clamp(12px,1.4vw,18px);padding:3px 8px}.v26-room-head small{font-size:9px}.v26-room{padding:5px}.v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,13px);padding:3px 5px}.v26-number,.v26-check{width:21px;height:21px}.v26-bottom{height:46px;min-height:46px;padding:3px 5px}.v26-stats span,.v26-menu-buttons button{min-height:32px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:11px}#end .v26-end-overlay{gap:3px;padding:7px}#end .v26-end-overlay h1{font-size:36px}#end .v26-end-overlay p{font-size:13px}#end .v26-end-buttons button{min-height:32px;padding:4px 12px}#modalWrap .modalBody{padding:8px!important}.v26-mini{gap:4px}.v26-mini h2{font-size:21px}.v26-mini p{font-size:12px}.v26-wash-visual{height:135px}.v26-bug-tray{height:165px}.v26-rapid-layout>img{height:140px}.v26-scrub{min-height:57px}.v26-game-main{min-height:44px;font-size:18px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v26-secret,.v26-bug-body,.v26-wash-bubbles i,.v26-ending-particles i,#v26-confetti i{animation:none!important}}
/* Critical: legacy global header-hide rule must not hide the new in-game header. */
#play header.v26-top{display:flex!important;visibility:visible!important}
#play .v26-room-head{display:flex!important}
#play .v26-top .v26-tabs{display:flex!important}
/* On narrow portrait screens, one clean footer row opens a full visible menu instead of clipping buttons. */
.v26-mobile-menu-trigger{display:none;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.93),rgba(222,238,247,.89));border-radius:999px;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 2px #fff,0 4px 7px #32617930;color:#244c68;font-size:13px;font-weight:1000;min-height:38px;padding:7px 15px;touch-action:manipulation}
.v26-menu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(7px,2vw,15px);padding:clamp(5px,2vw,17px)}
.v26-menu-grid button{min-height:70px;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid #fff;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff,#e7f1f8);box-shadow:0 4px 10px #34607222;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(13px,3vw,18px);color:#245368;padding:9px 5px;line-height:1.35;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.v26-menu-grid button[data-v26-action=reset]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe4ec,#f7a6c1);color:#9a3053}
#modalWrap .missionIcon,#modalWrap .stamp{display:none!important}
#toast{position:fixed!important;top:auto!important;bottom:clamp(83px,11vh,110px)!important;max-width:80vw!important;z-index:80!important;left:50%!important;transform:translateX(-50%)!important;border-radius:99px!important;font-weight:950!important;text-align:center!important}
@media(max-width:900px) and (orientation:landscape){.v26-room-grid{min-width:0!important}.v26-device img{max-height:calc(100% - 28px)}.v26-room-head h2{font-size:clamp(11px,1.6vw,15px)}.v26-room-head small{font-size:8px}.v26-device strong{font-size:10px}.v26-secret{width:30px;height:30px;font-size:9px}}
@media(max-width:720px) and (orientation:portrait){.v26-bottom{justify-content:space-between;overflow:visible!important}.v26-menu-buttons{display:none!important}.v26-mobile-menu-trigger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}.v26-stats{min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;border:0;margin:0;padding:0;gap:3px}.v26-stats span{flex:1 1 auto;padding:6px 3px;font-size:10px;min-width:0}#toast{bottom:85px!important;max-width:90vw!important;white-space:normal!important;font-size:12px!important}}
#end .v26-ending-art{object-fit:cover!important;filter:none!important}
#end .v26-end-overlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(12,48,65,0),rgba(13,56,70,.62) 20%,rgba(10,50,63,.84))!important}
@media(orientation:portrait){#end .v26-ending-art{object-fit:contain!important}}
/* Device widths below 950px cannot fit 12 readable buttons; keep a single row with an accessible menu. */
@media(max-width:950px){.v26-bottom{justify-content:space-between;overflow:visible!important}.v26-menu-buttons{display:none!important}.v26-mobile-menu-trigger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}.v26-stats{min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;border:0;margin:0;padding:0;gap:3px}.v26-stats span{flex:1 1 auto;padding:6px 3px;font-size:clamp(10px,1.45vw,13px);min-width:0}}
/* A subtle transparent gold flourish under the native title lettering. */
.v26-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:6px;right:16px;height:4px;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#f6c86b 15%,#fff5c9 48%,#f4be61 80%,transparent);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(65,54,24,.16);pointer-events:none}
/* Portrait phone: rearrange the same seven rooms into a readable two-column full-map layout. */
@media(max-width:600px) and (orientation:portrait){
 .v26-board-scroller{overflow:hidden!important}
 .v26-room-grid{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
 .v26-front{grid-area:1/1/2/2!important}.v26-prep{grid-area:1/2/2/3!important}
 .v26-storage{grid-area:2/1/3/2!important}.v26-cut{grid-area:2/2/3/3!important}
 .v26-cook{grid-area:3/1/5/2!important}.v26-wash{grid-area:3/2/4/3!important}.v26-clean{grid-area:4/2/5/3!important}
 .v26-room{padding:3px!important;border-width:2px!important;border-radius:10px!important}
 .v26-room-head{gap:1px!important}.v26-room-head h2{font-size:clamp(11px,3.1vw,15px)!important;line-height:1.15!important;padding:3px 7px!important;border-width:1px!important}
 .v26-room-head small{font-size:clamp(8px,1.9vw,10px)!important;padding-left:4px!important;line-height:1.1!important}
 .v26-devices{padding:0!important;gap:1px!important}
 .v26-device{padding:1px!important;gap:1px!important}
 .v26-device img,.v26-cook .v26-device img{max-height:calc(100% - 25px)!important}
 .v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(9px,2.25vw,11px)!important;padding:3px 4px!important;line-height:1.06!important}
 .v26-number,.v26-check{width:19px!important;height:19px!important;font-size:10px!important;border-width:1px!important}
 .v26-cook .v26-devices{gap:0!important}
 .v26-cook .v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(8px,2vw,10px)!important}
 .v26-secret{right:5px!important;bottom:6px!important;width:29px!important;height:29px!important;font-size:9px!important;border-width:1px!important}
 .v26-brand-main{font-size:clamp(18px,4.8vw,24px)!important}
}
@media(min-width:601px) and (max-width:1000px){.v26-room-grid{min-width:0!important}}
#play .v26-stage{background:rgba(224,242,241,.18)!important}
#play .v26-stage::before{opacity:.93!important;filter:blur(10px) saturate(.85)!important}
#play .v26-room::before{opacity:.16!important}
@media(max-width:600px) and (orientation:portrait){.v26-cook .v26-secret{bottom:50%!important;right:2px!important;transform:translateY(50%)!important;animation:none!important}}

:root{--v26-kitchen:url("data:image/webp;base64,");}

/* === Ver.2.8: official transparent title artwork, safe text and STAR CARD capture === */
#play .v26-top{gap:clamp(5px,1vw,18px);padding:0 clamp(6px,.8vw,14px)}
#play .v27-brand{flex:0 1 clamp(255px,41.5vw,560px)!important;min-width:0;min-height:0;align-self:center;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;position:relative;padding:0 3px!important;line-height:1!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(27,70,83,.25))!important;overflow:visible!important;background:transparent!important}
#play .v27-brand-logo{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:clamp(65px,12vh,120px);max-width:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center;image-rendering:auto}
#play .v27-version{position:absolute!important;right:-2px;bottom:2px!important;z-index:2;font-size:clamp(8px,.8vw,13px);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 6px!important;background:rgba(251,254,255,.96)!important;color:#135371!important;text-shadow:none!important;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(21,62,78,.12)}
#play .v26-tabs{max-width:570px;min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto}
#play .v26-tabs button{min-width:0;white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:keep-all;line-height:1.15}
#play .v26-room-head h2,#play .v26-room-head small,#play .v26-device strong{max-width:100%;white-space:normal!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;overflow:visible!important;text-overflow:clip!important;line-height:1.25!important}
#play .v26-device{min-width:0;overflow:visible}
#play .v26-device img{max-width:100%;object-fit:contain}
#play .v26-menu-buttons button,#play .v26-stats span,#play .v26-mobile-menu-trigger{white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-align:center;line-height:1.25}
#modalWrap .modalTitle{min-width:0;white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:keep-all!important;line-height:1.32!important;overflow:visible!important}
#modalWrap .modalBody,#modalWrap .challengeCard,#modalWrap .challengeQuestion,#modalWrap .options,#modalWrap .option{min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;word-break:keep-all!important;white-space:normal!important}
#modalWrap .option{min-height:52px!important;height:auto!important;line-height:1.45!important;overflow:visible!important;padding:12px 13px!important;text-overflow:clip!important}
#modalWrap .starAlbum,#modalWrap .v25-album,#modalWrap .v25-book{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
#modalWrap .v25-page-title,#modalWrap .v25-complete-tag,#modalWrap .v25-complete-burst h3{white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;line-height:1.2!important}
/* make the original equipment image float without introducing a substitute drawing */
#play [data-v26-device="9"] img{filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 12px rgba(19,63,69,.18));object-fit:contain}
#modalWrap .missionDevicePreview[src*="data:image/webp"]{object-fit:contain}
/* card is presented in full-size light, then flies into the actual blue page binder */
#cardCaptureOverlay.v27-capture{z-index:650!important;position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:auto!important;isolation:isolate;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 49% 46%,rgba(18,79,113,.44),rgba(8,24,56,.90) 80%);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);overflow:hidden}
#cardCaptureOverlay.v27-capture.visible{display:flex!important}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-scene{position:relative;width:min(1080px,98vw);height:min(90dvh,770px);min-height:260px;display:block;isolation:isolate}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-light-rays{position:absolute;left:50%;top:42%;width:min(110vmin,800px);height:min(110vmin,800px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 15deg,rgba(255,239,166,.35) 0deg 5deg,transparent 5deg 19deg),radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,249,201,.85) 0%,rgba(253,218,116,.47) 29%,rgba(255,231,109,0) 67%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 4%,transparent 70%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 4%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(1.5px);animation:v27-rays 5s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes v27-rays{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-heading{position:absolute;z-index:15;left:50%;top:3%;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:95%;width:max-content;text-align:center;line-height:1.2;font-size:clamp(19px,4.2vw,37px);font-weight:1000;color:#fffbea;text-shadow:0 3px 20px rgba(39,32,90,.85),0 0 12px rgba(255,218,84,.8);letter-spacing:.025em;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-heading small{display:block;font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vw,17px);letter-spacing:.07em;margin-top:5px;color:#fff2c2}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-front{position:absolute;z-index:10;left:50%;top:46%;width:min(32vw,300px);max-width:70%;max-height:68%;aspect-ratio:2/3;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.5) rotateY(140deg);opacity:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.47)) drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(255,229,121,.8));transition:left 1.05s cubic-bezier(.23,.7,.16,1),top 1.05s cubic-bezier(.23,.7,.16,1),width 1.05s cubic-bezier(.23,.7,.16,1),transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.23,.7,.16,1),opacity .35s ease-out}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-front .originalStarCard{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;outline:3px solid rgba(255,249,207,.92);outline-offset:3px;box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(255,220,110,.74),0 20px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.36)}
#cardCaptureOverlay.visible .v27-capture-front{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1) rotateY(0)}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder{position:absolute;z-index:9;right:5%;bottom:9%;width:min(26vw,232px);height:min(18vw,157px);border-radius:15px;background:var(--v25book) center/100% 100% no-repeat;filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.4));transform:translateY(16px) scale(.72);opacity:0;transition:transform .55s ease-out,opacity .55s ease-out}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder-label{position:absolute;z-index:14;right:5%;bottom:3%;width:min(26vw,232px);text-align:center;color:#fff9dc;font-size:clamp(11px,1.4vw,16px);font-weight:950;text-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.6);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
#cardCaptureOverlay.visible .v27-capture-binder,#cardCaptureOverlay.visible .v27-capture-binder-label{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
#cardCaptureOverlay.collected .v27-capture-front{left:84%;top:79%;width:min(12vw,110px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.55) rotate(-16deg);opacity:0;transition:all 1.05s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.22,1)}
#cardCaptureOverlay.collected .v27-capture-binder{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 42px rgba(255,237,152,.9)) drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45));transform:scale(1.12)}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-footer{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:2%;width:96%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;z-index:20;font-size:clamp(12px,1.5vw,17px);color:#fff8df;font-weight:900;line-height:1.45;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-skip{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#fff;font-size:clamp(12px,1.5vw,16px);font-weight:900;pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer}
#cardCaptureOverlay.collected .v27-capture-heading{animation:v27-heading-complete .9s ease both}
@keyframes v27-heading-complete{70%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px #fff1a2)}}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-star{position:absolute;z-index:3;width:clamp(10px,2.3vw,24px);height:clamp(10px,2.3vw,24px);background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0%,#fff9ce 28%,#ffe288 45%,transparent 75%);clip-path:polygon(50% 0,62% 35%,100% 50%,62% 65%,50% 100%,38% 65%,0 50%,38% 35%);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #fff1a7);animation:v27-twinkle var(--dur,2.1s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;animation-delay:var(--delay,0s);left:var(--x);top:var(--y);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes v27-twinkle{from{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.55) rotate(0)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.6) rotate(45deg)}}
@media(max-width:920px){#play .v27-brand{flex:0 1 clamp(200px,38vw,380px)!important}#play .v27-brand-logo{max-height:clamp(50px,10vh,100px)} }
@media(max-width:720px){#play .v26-top{flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px}#play .v27-brand{flex:0 1 auto!important;width:min(66vw,320px);align-self:center}#play .v27-brand-logo{max-height:clamp(35px,7.5dvh,72px)}#play .v27-version{font-size:9px;bottom:0!important}#play .v26-tabs{width:100%;max-width:100%;min-height:30px}#play .v26-tabs button{min-height:30px}}
@media(max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape){#play .v26-top{min-height:45px!important}#play .v27-brand-logo{max-height:clamp(34px,9dvh,58px)}#play .v27-brand{flex:0 1 min(37vw,310px)!important}#play .v26-tabs button{padding:5px 6px}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-scene{height:98dvh}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-front{height:min(59dvh,310px);width:auto;aspect-ratio:2/3}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-heading{top:0;font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,27px)}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder{bottom:12%;width:min(19vw,150px);height:min(14vw,100px)}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder-label{bottom:3%}}
@media(max-width:500px) and (orientation:portrait){#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-heading{top:8%}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-front{width:min(59vw,250px);top:44%}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder{right:9%;bottom:12%;width:min(42vw,168px);height:110px}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder-label{right:9%;width:min(42vw,168px);bottom:7%}#cardCaptureOverlay.collected .v27-capture-front{left:72%;top:76%;width:min(21vw,80px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-star,#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-light-rays{animation:none!important}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-front{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}


/* Ver.2.8 finishing adjustment: footer and binder caption never overlap. */
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-footer{left:4%!important;bottom:3%!important;width:48%!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:flex-start!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:8px!important;text-align:left!important}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-footer span{max-width:100%;white-space:normal!important;word-break:keep-all!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder-label{bottom:3%!important;right:5%!important;max-width:40%!important;white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
@media(max-width:500px) and (orientation:portrait){#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-footer{bottom:3%!important;width:46%!important}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-binder-label{bottom:5%!important;right:6%!important;max-width:43%!important}#cardCaptureOverlay .v27-capture-skip{padding:8px 11px!important;font-size:11px!important}}
/* Ver.2.8 improvements — natural-ratio single-page card file and original school lunch mini-games */
#modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:min(720px,96vw)!important;max-height:96dvh!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-album{width:100%;min-height:0;max-height:calc(96dvh - 100px);align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-book{height:min(68dvh,670px)!important;max-height:min(68dvh,670px)!important;aspect-ratio:3/4!important;width:auto!important;max-width:min(90vw,520px)!important;min-height:0!important;flex:0 1 auto!important;background-image:var(--v28-single-book)!important;background-size:100% 100%!important;background-position:center center!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(19,55,89,.18)!important;border-radius:16px!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-page-title{display:none!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-page-inner{position:absolute;inset:11% 10% 11% 10%;min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;gap:9px}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-intro{font-size:clamp(10px,1.2vw,13px);line-height:1.45;text-align:center;color:#174b6b;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);padding:5px 8px;border-radius:8px;flex:0 0 auto}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-four{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(6px,1.3vw,13px);min-height:0;min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;align-content:center}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-four .v25-pocket{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:0;min-height:0;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.58)!important;border:1px solid rgba(22,108,158,.21)!important;padding:3px!important;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(14,53,76,.12)}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-four .v25-pocket img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-four .v25-collected:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #e6bb5b,0 10px 24px rgba(14,53,76,.16)!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page{text-align:center;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:1px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,247,193,.54),transparent 74%)}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-book-complete-title{font-size:clamp(19px,3vw,35px);line-height:1.1;font-weight:1000;color:#b76d19;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff,0 0 18px #fff3b6}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page h3{font-size:clamp(20px,3.2vw,36px);margin:0;color:#185fa1;line-height:1.2}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-crew{width:100%;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(2,1fr);gap:3px;place-items:center}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-crew img{width:100%;height:100%;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.13))}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page strong{font-size:clamp(12px,1.8vw,22px);color:#1e668b}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.4vw,15px);margin:0;color:#4a6a83}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-book-navigation{width:min(100%,570px);flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-book-hint{font-size:12px!important;margin:0;line-height:1.3;max-width:95%;text-align:center}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{overflow:auto!important;display:grid;place-items:center;max-height:calc(96dvh - 90px);padding:5px 8px!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-page-tabs{flex-wrap:nowrap}
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-page-tabs button{min-width:32px!important}
.v28-mini{width:100%;height:auto;min-height:0;max-width:100%;color:#1f4c58;line-height:1.5}
.v28-mini-head{text-align:center;padding:0 6px 8px}
.v28-mini-head span{display:block;color:#308596;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:900}
.v28-mini-head h2{font-size:clamp(21px,3vw,29px)!important;color:#194c58!important;margin:2px 0 6px!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
.v28-mini-head p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.65vw,15px);margin:0 auto 8px;max-width:660px;line-height:1.55;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.v28-hand-layout,.v28-sink-layout,.v28-love-panel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.9fr);align-items:center;gap:clamp(10px,2vw,22px)}
.v28-hand-box{width:100%;max-width:430px;aspect-ratio:560/517;position:relative;justify-self:center;border-radius:24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#fff 15%,#e8fafa);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(56,177,199,.15)}
.v28-hand-box img,.v28-hand-box canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.v28-hand-box canvas{touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair;z-index:2}
.v28-mini-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;gap:14px}
.v28-ticks{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:clamp(15px,2.2vw,22px);flex-wrap:wrap}
.v28-ticks b{color:#1786ac;font-size:1.15em}
.v28-meter{height:22px;background:#d9e8e7;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.12);overflow:hidden}
.v28-meter i{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4eaceb,#64dbc4,#b5eafe);border-radius:22px;transition:width .13s}
.v28-hero-button{border:2px solid #fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;align-self:center;min-height:52px!important;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 22px;font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,21px);font-weight:950;color:#194555;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff7c0,#ffc35f);box-shadow:0 6px 0 #d49a45,0 10px 20px rgba(67,91,92,.16);touch-action:manipulation;white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all;cursor:pointer}
.v28-hero-button:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #d49a45}
.v28-caption{font-size:clamp(13px,1.7vw,17px);font-weight:800;text-align:center;color:#226c80;line-height:1.5}
.v28-hand-keyguide{font-size:clamp(11px,1.25vw,13px);line-height:1.5;text-align:center;color:#55727c}
.v28-sink-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr)}
.v28-sink-art{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.v28-sink-art img{display:block;width:100%;max-width:330px;max-height:220px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:13px}
.v28-sink-art strong{font-size:15px;text-align:center}
.v28-sink-game{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center;min-width:0}
.v28-sink-phase{font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(13px,1.8vw,18px);text-align:center;min-height:1.5em}
.v28-sink-cards{display:flex;width:100%;min-width:0;gap:8px;justify-content:center;min-height:170px}
.v28-veggie{min-width:0;flex:1 1 0;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;border-radius:16px;border:2px solid rgba(93,168,155,.36);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f6ffea,#c8efc3);padding:6px;box-shadow:0 8px 13px rgba(38,78,60,.10);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.v28-veggie img{width:100%;max-width:132px;max-height:130px;object-fit:contain}
.v28-veggie small{position:absolute;left:6px;top:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#307e75;padding:2px 6px;font-weight:900}
.v28-veggie:disabled{opacity:1!important;cursor:default}
.v28-veggie:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:#ffc451}
.v28-bug-icon{display:none;position:absolute;right:8%;top:16%;width:44px;height:44px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.18))}
.v28-has-bug .v28-bug-icon{display:block}
.v28-sink-feedback{font-size:clamp(12px,1.6vw,15px);font-weight:800;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;color:#446b77;min-height:2em}
.v28-sink-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center}
.v28-educational-note{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#5d7479;margin:10px 0 0;text-align:center}
.v28-love-visual{text-align:center;min-width:0}
.v28-love-visual img{width:100%;max-width:340px;max-height:240px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto}
.v28-love-score{height:48px;line-height:48px;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,31px);font-weight:1000;color:#d48a34;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff}
.v28-love-game{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0;align-items:center}
.v28-love-count{font-size:clamp(16px,2.5vw,22px);font-weight:950;color:#20526b}
.v28-love-track{position:relative;width:100%;height:30px;border:2px solid rgba(13,99,125,.25);border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#bddef8,#e7f2f7);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px rgba(24,69,92,.2)}
.v28-love-zone{position:absolute;left:43.5%;width:13%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff4ba,#ffc567);box-shadow:0 0 25px #ffe89a}
.v28-love-needle{position:absolute;left:0;top:-6px;bottom:-6px;width:13px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff7fb5,#ea4798);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #fff,0 0 13px rgba(234,71,152,.55)}
.v28-love-legend{font-size:12px;color:#4f6a77;text-align:center}
.v28-love-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.v28-mini button:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #409cce;outline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:650px){.v28-hand-layout,.v28-sink-layout,.v28-love-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:10px}.v28-hand-box{width:min(53vw,250px)}.v28-mini-right{gap:7px}.v28-sink-art img{max-height:100px}.v28-sink-cards{min-height:120px}.v28-veggie img{max-height:96px}.v28-love-visual img{max-height:100px}.v28-love-score{height:28px;line-height:28px}.v28-mini-head p{font-size:12px}.v28-hand-keyguide{display:none}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (orientation:landscape){.v28-hand-box{max-width:220px}.v28-mini-head h2{font-size:20px!important}.v28-mini-head p{font-size:11px}.v28-sink-art img{max-height:95px}.v28-veggie img{max-height:90px}.v28-sink-cards{min-height:90px}.v28-love-visual img{max-height:128px}#modalWrap.starMode .v25-book{height:min(60dvh,420px)!important;max-height:min(60dvh,420px)!important}}

/* Final responsive correction: portrait book ratio is preserved on narrow phones. */
#modalWrap.starMode .v25-book{
  width:min(90vw,51dvh,502px)!important;
  height:auto!important;
  max-width:min(90vw,502px)!important;
  max-height:68dvh!important;
  aspect-ratio:3/4!important;
  flex:0 0 auto!important;
}
@media (max-height:500px) and (orientation:landscape){
  #modalWrap.starMode .v25-book{width:min(90vw,45dvh)!important;height:auto!important;max-height:60dvh!important}
}
.v28-mini [hidden],.v28-hero-button[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Page four: contain the four original mascots without covering the completion message. */
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-rows:auto auto minmax(0,1fr) auto auto!important;
  justify-items:center!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:stretch!important;
  gap:3px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page .v28-complete-crew{
  display:grid!important;
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  max-height:100%!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  align-items:stretch!important;
  justify-items:center!important;
  gap:0!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page .v28-complete-crew img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  max-height:100%!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page strong,
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page p{
  display:block!important;
  position:relative!important;
  z-index:3!important;
  width:100%!important;
  margin:0!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;
  word-break:keep-all!important;
  line-height:1.2!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.78)!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  padding:2px 4px!important;
  text-align:center!important;
}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page strong{font-size:clamp(11px,1.4vw,16px)!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .v28-complete-page p{font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,13px)!important}

/* Ver.2.9: SLC timing clarity and actual animated memory cards */
.v29-love-panel{align-items:center}
.v29-love-heading{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,26px);font-weight:900;color:#174459;line-height:1.4;margin:4px auto 16px}
.v29-love-track{position:relative;height:42px;max-width:590px;margin:0 auto 6px;border-radius:40px;overflow:visible;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e5f2f7,#bcd9e2);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px #55717d35,0 4px 14px #1a607433}
.v29-love-good{position:absolute;left:31%;width:38%;height:100%;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe6a3,#fac47f)}
.v29-love-perfect{position:absolute;left:43.5%;width:13%;height:100%;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffc7d8,#ff6d9c);box-shadow:0 0 14px #f9689699;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#792041;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(11px,1.3vw,15px);white-space:nowrap}
.v29-love-track .v28-love-needle{z-index:3;width:9px;top:-8px;bottom:-8px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffffffdd,0 5px 8px #17445980}
.v29-love-legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;max-width:590px;margin:8px auto 17px;color:#204a58;font-size:clamp(12px,1.7vw,16px);font-weight:800}
.v29-love-legend strong{color:#bd326d;text-align:center}
.v29-love-hit{box-shadow:0 0 24px #6ddcbba8,inset 0 3px 8px #55717d35}
.v29-love-perfect-hit{box-shadow:0 0 26px 10px #ffb1caaf,inset 0 3px 8px #55717d35}
.v29-sink-game{min-width:0}
.v29-sink-cards{position:relative!important;display:block!important;height:clamp(160px,25vh,245px)!important;width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important;padding:0!important}
.v29-sink-card{position:absolute!important;top:3px!important;min-width:0!important;height:calc(100% - 9px)!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;justify-content:center!important;align-items:center!important;transition-property:left,box-shadow,transform!important;transition-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.v29-sink-card img{max-width:90%!important;max-height:73%!important;object-fit:contain!important}
.v29-sink-card .v28-bug-icon{z-index:5}
.v29-sink-card.v29-wash-answer{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #fff,0 0 25px 8px #ffd86f!important}
.v29-sink-card.v29-key-selected{outline:4px solid #65adf8!important;outline-offset:-4px!important}
.v29-sink-card[disabled]{opacity:1!important;cursor:default}
.v29-sink-head h2,.v29-love-head h2{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media (max-width:700px){
.v29-sink-cards{height:clamp(135px,27vh,210px)!important}
.v29-sink-card small{font-size:12px!important}
.v29-sink-card img{max-height:65%!important}
.v29-love-legend{font-size:12px}
}


/* Ver.3.25: 12 equipment layout. Preserve all existing 10 assets/missions. */
.v26-prep .v26-devices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(2px,.25vw,5px);align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch}
.v26-prep .v26-device{padding:2px;min-width:0}
.v26-prep .v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(10px,.98vw,14px);padding:3px 4px;white-space:normal}
.v26-cook .v26-devices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(2px,.3vw,7px)!important}
.v26-cook .v26-device{min-width:0;min-height:0;padding:2px}
.v26-cook .v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(10px,.9vw,16px);padding:4px 5px}
.v26-device[data-v26-device="11"] img,.v26-device[data-v26-device="12"] img{object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(15,43,46,.28))}
.station[data-id="2"],.station[data-id="11"]{width:107px;height:119px;padding:3px}
.v26-prep .v26-secret{right:2px!important;bottom:2px!important;width:24px!important;height:24px!important;font-size:8px!important;}
.station[data-id="2"] .stIcon,.station[data-id="11"] .stIcon{height:83px}
.station[data-id="11"] .stIcon img,.station[data-id="12"] .stIcon img{object-fit:contain;width:100%;height:100%}
.station[data-id="2"] .stName,.station[data-id="11"] .stName{font-size:11px;padding:3px 5px}
.v30-secret-story{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(8px,2vw,17px);text-align:left;margin:0 auto 9px;max-width:570px}
.v30-secret-story p{font-size:clamp(13px,2.6vw,16px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.7;max-width:340px;margin:0}
.v30-secret-wizard{display:block;width:clamp(90px,18vw,185px);height:clamp(105px,23vh,205px);object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 8px rgba(109,70,21,.25))}
.v30-secret-symbol{font-size:clamp(42px,8vw,70px);flex:0 0 95px;text-align:center}
.v30-secret-answer{margin:10px auto;padding:12px;background:#f2fff2;border:2px solid #95dba4;border-radius:15px;text-align:left;max-width:540px}
.v30-secret-answer strong{font-size:19px;color:#238456}
.v30-secret-answer p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;font-weight:750;color:#465846}
.v30-secret-answer .mainBtn{display:block;margin:8px auto 0}
@media(max-width:650px){.v26-prep .v26-device strong,.v26-cook .v26-device strong{font-size:clamp(10px,2.6vw,13px)}.v26-cook .v26-devices{gap:2px!important}.v30-secret-story p{font-size:12px}.v30-secret-wizard{width:98px;height:120px}.v30-secret-symbol{flex-basis:58px;font-size:44px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:550px){.v30-secret-story{gap:6px}.v30-secret-wizard{height:80px;width:80px}.v30-secret-answer{padding:8px}.v30-secret-story p{font-size:12px}}


/* Ver.3.25 — original book photograph, gold glow and non-destructive cover lettering */
.v26-secret,.v26-secret.found{
  display:flex!important; flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:clamp(60px,6vw,94px)!important;height:clamp(58px,5.5vw,82px)!important;
  border:0!important;border-radius:17px!important;padding:4px!important;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 45% 40%,rgba(255,255,232,.94) 0%,rgba(255,231,148,.74) 43%,rgba(255,212,73,.21) 75%,transparent 100%)!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 14px 5px rgba(255,222,90,.64),0 0 32px 5px rgba(255,194,56,.60)!important;
  color:#604322!important; animation:v31TomeGlow 1.75s ease-in-out infinite!important; overflow:visible!important;
}
.v26-secret:not(.found)::before,.spark::before{
  content:'✦';position:absolute;z-index:3;top:-9px;right:0;font-size:17px;color:#fff7bc;
  text-shadow:0 0 5px #ffd537,0 0 11px #f8bb31;animation:v31Twinkle 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.v26-secret.found{opacity:.84;animation:none!important;box-shadow:0 0 9px 2px rgba(246,221,153,.5)!important;}
.v26-secret.found .v31-book-mark{color:#fff4c6}
.v31-tome-art{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;height:65%;flex:0 0 auto;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 4px rgba(58,43,24,.38))}
.v31-tome-art img{display:block;object-fit:contain;width:100%;height:100%;mix-blend-mode:multiply;pointer-events:none}
.v31-book-mark{position:absolute;left:50%;top:35%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-12deg) skew(-6deg);z-index:3;color:#f1d78d;font-size:clamp(13px,1.7vw,22px);line-height:1;font-weight:1000;text-shadow:-1px -1px #4b3824,1px 1px #402a13,0 0 6px #ffe39f;pointer-events:none}
.v31-tome-label{display:block;position:relative;z-index:4;line-height:1.2;font-size:clamp(10px,.85vw,12px);font-weight:1000;background:rgba(255,253,241,.9);padding:1px 7px;border-radius:90px;border:1px solid rgba(243,218,170,.8);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(54,40,19,.14)}
.v31-tome-done{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;background:#51b38a;color:#fff;border:1px solid white;border-radius:50%;width:21px;height:21px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;z-index:5}
.v26-secret:hover,.v26-secret:focus-visible{filter:brightness(1.14);outline:3px solid #d0a13c;outline-offset:2px}
@keyframes v31TomeGlow{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);filter:brightness(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.07);filter:brightness(1.12)}}
@keyframes v31Twinkle{50%{opacity:.3;transform:rotate(24deg) scale(.7)}}
.v31-wizard-guide{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0}
.v31-wizard-guide img{width:clamp(95px,16vw,180px);height:clamp(100px,20vh,170px);object-fit:contain;margin:0}
.v31-wizard-guide span{font-size:10px;background:#f9e9bf;border-radius:40px;border:1px solid #dec58f;color:#744a31;padding:3px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.v31-wizard-quote{background:#fffdf5;border:1px solid #ead1a3;border-radius:16px;padding:11px 13px;box-shadow:0 4px 9px #ac76301b}
.v31-wizard-quote strong{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#bb7731;margin-bottom:4px}
.v30-secret-answer{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fffbed,#f2fff4);border-color:#e0c58b}
.v30-secret-answer strong{color:#93642f}
.v26-device img,.missionDevicePreview{object-fit:contain!important;background:transparent!important;image-rendering:auto}
/* Legacy coordinates remain available if the older map is ever shown. */
.spark:has(.v31-tome-art){background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff8d2,transparent 77%)!important;color:transparent!important;border:none!important;box-shadow:0 0 20px 7px #ffdc70aa!important}
.spark .v31-book-mark{font-size:17px}
@media(max-width:650px){.v26-secret,.v26-secret.found{width:64px!important;height:59px!important;bottom:5px!important;right:5px!important}.v31-book-mark{font-size:16px}.v31-tome-label{font-size:9px}.v31-wizard-guide img{width:95px;height:100px}.v31-wizard-quote{padding:8px;font-size:12px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:550px){.v31-wizard-guide img{width:72px;height:72px}.v31-wizard-quote{padding:7px}.v31-wizard-guide span{font-size:9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v26-secret,.v26-secret.found,.spark::before,.v26-secret::before{animation:none!important}}


/* Ver.3.25 | Full-screen, two-page card binder & washroom mystery position */
.v26-wash .v26-secret{top:clamp(62px,12vh,95px)!important;right:clamp(10px,2vw,27px)!important;bottom:auto!important;left:auto!important;transform:none!important;z-index:5!important}
.v26-wash .v26-room-head{position:relative;z-index:6}
#modalWrap.starMode{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;padding:0!important;align-items:stretch!important;justify-content:stretch!important;background:rgba(6,21,42,.90)!important;z-index:210!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:100vw!important;height:100dvh!important;max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;min-height:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%,#314a65 0%,#0b223a 65%,#08192d 100%)!important;color:#fff!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalTop{flex:0 0 auto!important;min-height:49px!important;max-height:60px!important;padding:7px clamp(12px,2vw,30px)!important;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#1c3150,#253e62)!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,222,153,.35)!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalTitle{font-size:clamp(14px,1.65vw,22px)!important;color:#fff5d7!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .closeBtn{width:39px!important;height:39px!important;min-width:39px!important;min-height:39px!important;color:#354660!important;background:#fff4d7!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{flex:1 1 auto!important;min-height:0!important;min-width:0!important;padding:clamp(4px,.8vh,9px) clamp(5px,1vw,15px) clamp(5px,1vh,12px)!important;display:flex!important;overflow:hidden!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;scrollbar-gutter:auto!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalFooter{display:none!important}
.ft-file{height:100%;width:100%;min-height:0;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(4px,.8vh,9px);overflow:hidden}
.ft-file-top{width:min(97vw,1350px);display:flex;flex:0 0 auto;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 5px;font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,15px);color:#fff4d8}
.ft-file-top b{font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,19px);white-space:nowrap}
.ft-file-top span{color:#ffe5aa;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.ft-book-spread{position:relative;flex:0 1 auto;height:min(calc(100dvh - 166px),calc(96vw / 1.55));width:auto;max-height:calc(100% - 74px);max-width:97vw;aspect-ratio:1.55;min-height:0;min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));border:clamp(3px,.55vw,9px) solid #a77936;border-radius:clamp(8px,1.5vw,21px);overflow:hidden;background:#d9ecf4;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffda8b55,0 14px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 0 0 15px #fff9e3;isolation:isolate}
.ft-book-spread::before{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;left:calc(50% - 11px);width:22px;top:0;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(22,52,77,.58),rgba(255,248,222,.58) 42%,rgba(31,66,94,.48) 58%,rgba(7,33,58,.56));box-shadow:0 0 14px #06375d44}
.ft-book-spread::after{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;inset:0;border:2px solid #f9e5a8aa;border-radius:12px}
.ft-page{position:relative;min-height:0;min-width:0;background-color:#d4ebf6;background-image:var(--ft-book-bg);background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;overflow:hidden}
.ft-page:first-child{border-right:1px solid #be9b5c}
.ft-page:last-child{border-left:1px solid #f7da93}
.ft-page-inner{position:absolute;inset:14.5% 11.5% 13% 11.5%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:0;gap:clamp(1px,.4vw,8px)}
.ft-page-topline{flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;color:#1d5882;text-shadow:0 1px #fff;font-size:clamp(9px,1.05vw,16px);font-weight:950;line-height:1.15;white-space:nowrap}
.ft-page-pockets{display:grid;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;min-height:0;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(3px,.6vw,12px)}
.ft-page .v25-pocket{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;min-width:0!important;min-height:0!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:clamp(5px,.7vw,12px)!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.83)!important;border:1px solid rgba(157,195,220,.75)!important;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #27507123!important;padding:clamp(2px,.38vw,6px)!important;gap:clamp(2px,.4vw,6px)!important;color:#477294!important}
.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-collected{background:rgba(255,251,232,.95)!important;border:2px solid #e9b862!important;cursor:pointer!important;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-collected:hover,.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-collected:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.03)!important;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ffd77b!important;z-index:2}
.ft-page .v25-pocket .originalStarCard{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;display:block}
.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-locked b{font-size:clamp(10px,1.1vw,18px)!important}
.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-locked span{font-size:clamp(9px,.9vw,15px)!important}
.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-empty{font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,17px)}
.ft-page-complete{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(2px,.7vh,9px);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,248,.78);color:#26577a;text-align:center;padding:7px}
.ft-page-complete h3{font-size:clamp(13px,2.1vw,34px);margin:0;line-height:1.17;color:#c78626}
.ft-page-complete p{font-size:clamp(9px,.9vw,15px);margin:0;line-height:1.35}
.ft-page-complete .ft-crew{width:100%;min-height:0;flex:1 1 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px}
.ft-page-complete .ft-crew img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;min-height:0}
.ft-page-locked{font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,64px)}
.ft-file-nav{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(5px,1.4vw,20px);min-height:44px;max-width:97vw;flex-wrap:nowrap}
.ft-file-nav button{cursor:pointer;border:2px solid #fff3d4;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #00152744;background:linear-gradient(#fff9e9,#e9e9e0);border-radius:99px;min-height:40px;padding:7px clamp(10px,1.7vw,25px);font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,17px);font-weight:950;color:#1b4a6a;white-space:nowrap}
.ft-file-nav button:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed}
.ft-file-nav strong{color:#fff1c5;font-size:clamp(11px,1.15vw,18px);white-space:nowrap}
.ft-file-nav .ft-return{background:linear-gradient(#ffe7a9,#ffc772);border-color:#ffe4a1;color:#52341c}
.ft-preview{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:12;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(9px,3vw,23px);background:rgba(5,24,44,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.ft-preview.active{display:flex}
.ft-detail{height:100%;max-height:100%;max-width:min(580px,95%);width:min(520px,95%);min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:clamp(4px,.7vh,10px);padding:clamp(9px,1.7vw,20px);background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fffdf7,#fff0ce);border:4px solid #e9c27c;border-radius:20px;color:#5d4b37;overflow:auto}
.ft-detail img{max-width:100%;max-height:69%;min-height:0;flex:1 1 auto;object-fit:contain}
.ft-detail h3{font-size:clamp(14px,1.8vw,21px);margin:0;color:#275a76}
.ft-detail p{font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,15px);margin:0;line-height:1.45}
.ft-detail button{flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:100px;background:#1c6899;color:white;border:0;padding:9px 19px;min-height:39px;font-weight:950}
@media (orientation:portrait){.ft-file-top{padding:0 4px}.ft-file-top span{display:none}.ft-book-spread{width:97vw;height:auto;max-height:min(76dvh,calc(97vw / 1.55));aspect-ratio:1.55}.ft-page-inner{inset:15% 10% 13% 10%}.ft-page-pockets{gap:3px}.ft-page-topline{font-size:9px}.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-locked b{font-size:9px}.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-locked span{font-size:8px}.ft-file-nav button{min-height:39px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}.ft-file-nav strong{font-size:11px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:480px){#modalWrap.starMode .modalTop{max-height:37px!important;min-height:36px!important;padding:2px 12px!important}.ft-file-top{display:none}.ft-book-spread{height:min(calc(100dvh - 91px),calc(95vw / 1.55));max-height:calc(100% - 43px)}.ft-file-nav{min-height:35px}.ft-file-nav button{min-height:33px;padding:4px 10px}.ft-page-inner{inset:14.8% 11% 12% 11%}.ft-page-topline{font-size:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ft-page .v25-pocket.v25-collected{transition:none!important}}


/* Portrait phones: preserve full two-page artwork while using screen height. */
@media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:650px){
 .ft-file{position:relative;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
 .ft-file-top{position:absolute;top:3px;left:0;right:0;width:100%;z-index:3;padding:0 4px}
 .ft-file-top:after{content:'見開きは横向きで表示中';font-size:10px;color:#ffe0a1;white-space:nowrap;margin-inline:auto}
 .ft-file-top span{display:none}
 .ft-book-spread{position:absolute!important;left:50%!important;top:48%!important;flex:none!important;display:grid!important;width:min(calc(100dvh - 155px),calc((100vw - 24px)*1.55))!important;height:auto!important;max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;min-width:0!important;min-height:0!important;aspect-ratio:1.55!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg)!important;transform-origin:center!important}
 .ft-file-nav{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:0;right:0;margin:auto;min-width:0;z-index:5;justify-content:center}
}

/* Ver.3.25 card file / secret book brush-up */
#modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:min(98vw,1580px)!important;height:min(97dvh,980px)!important;max-height:97dvh!important;border-radius:20px!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{padding:10px 12px 12px!important;background:radial-gradient(circle at top,#18496a 0%,#0c2f46 58%,#0a2436 100%)!important}
#modalWrap.starMode .modalTop{padding:10px 14px!important}
.v36-guide-shell{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:0;color:#fff7df}
.v36-guide-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:0 6px;flex:0 0 auto;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,16px);font-weight:900}
.v36-guide-top b{font-size:clamp(13px,1.15vw,20px);white-space:nowrap;color:#fff7d2}
.v36-guide-top span{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#ffe6ac;text-align:center}
.v36-book-stage{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:0}
.v36-book-spread{position:relative;width:min(95vw,1500px);max-height:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;background-image:var(--v36-book-bg);background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.42));overflow:visible}
.v36-pageArea{position:absolute;top:14.7%;bottom:12.5%;width:34.2%;display:grid;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3.5%;align-items:stretch}
.v36-pageArea.left{left:7.4%}
.v36-pageArea.right{right:7.4%}
.v36-book-tag{position:absolute;top:7.2%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:6px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,251,235,.85);color:#966823;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,16px);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(67,42,7,.18)}
.v36-spread-index{position:absolute;bottom:6.8%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:5px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(22,89,142,.88);color:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.86);font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(11px,.95vw,15px);letter-spacing:.03em}
.v36-complete-ribbon{position:absolute;left:50%;top:9.8%;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-1.5deg);padding:7px 22px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe38f,#ffb64e);color:#6a3f00;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,22px);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(131,79,6,.22)}
.v36-pocket{appearance:none;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid rgba(198,170,110,.58);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.72),rgba(245,243,234,.84));box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(54,59,72,.12),inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.42);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;padding:8px;position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;transition:transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease}
.v36-pocket::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.72);pointer-events:none}
.v36-pocket.v36-collected{cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,253,245,.95),rgba(255,248,223,.96));border-color:#ebb963}
.v36-pocket.v36-collected:hover,.v36-pocket.v36-collected:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(54,59,72,.18),0 0 0 4px rgba(255,219,125,.3)}
.v36-pocket.v36-collected .originalStarCard{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.v36-pocket.v36-locked,.v36-pocket.v36-empty{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;text-align:center;color:#5e7488}
.v36-pocket.v36-locked b,.v36-pocket.v36-empty b{font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,24px);color:#386b93;line-height:1.1}
.v36-pocket.v36-locked span,.v36-pocket.v36-empty span{font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,15px);line-height:1.35;font-weight:900}
.v36-pocket.v36-locked i,.v36-pocket.v36-empty i{font-style:normal;font-size:clamp(30px,2.4vw,42px)}
.v36-guide-nav{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v36-guide-nav button{appearance:none;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf0,#ffe8bf);color:#2f5575;border-radius:999px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18);cursor:pointer}
.v36-guide-nav button:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed}
.v36-guide-nav .v36-return{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe39d,#ffbf63);color:#64390d}
.v36-guide-nav strong{color:#fff4c7;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,17px);padding:0 4px}
.v36-preview{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(12px,2vw,24px);background:rgba(8,26,43,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border-radius:28px;z-index:5}
.v36-preview.active{display:flex}
.v36-preview-card{width:min(580px,94%);max-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdf7,#ffefc9);border:4px solid #e8c279;border-radius:24px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.22);color:#5d4935;overflow:auto}
.v36-preview-card img{width:auto;max-width:100%;height:min(60dvh,620px);object-fit:contain;display:block}
.v36-preview-card h3{margin:0;font-size:clamp(18px,1.7vw,24px);color:#245c83}
.v36-preview-card p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px);line-height:1.55;text-align:center}
.v36-preview-card button{border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#1d6b9d;color:#fff;padding:10px 22px;min-height:42px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer}
.spark.v36-secret-book{width:88px;height:88px;background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;filter:none;animation:none}
.spark.v36-secret-book::before,.spark.v36-secret-book::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.spark.v36-secret-book::before{width:112px;height:112px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,251,198,.98) 0%,rgba(255,232,132,.74) 32%,rgba(255,204,95,.36) 54%,rgba(255,190,76,.08) 72%,transparent 76%);filter:blur(5px);animation:v36Aura 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.spark.v36-secret-book::after{content:'✦';inset:auto;right:7px;top:2px;transform:none;color:#fff6b9;font-size:24px;text-shadow:0 0 10px #ffe470,0 0 22px rgba(255,220,84,.95);animation:v36Twinkle 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.spark.v36-secret-book .v36-secret-shell{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,230,116,.95)) drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(255,188,66,.62));animation:v36BookFloat 2.15s ease-in-out infinite}
.spark.v36-secret-book img{width:82px;height:82px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.spark.v36-secret-book.got::before{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(186,255,214,.78) 0%,rgba(105,224,158,.36) 46%,transparent 74%)}
.spark.v36-secret-book.got .v36-secret-shell{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(147,255,190,.75)) drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(68,179,122,.48));opacity:.88}
.spark.v36-secret-book.got::after{color:#effff0;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(160,255,195,.95)}
@keyframes v36Aura{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.94);opacity:.76}50%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes v36BookFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(3deg)}}
@keyframes v36Twinkle{from{transform:scale(.86) rotate(-10deg);opacity:.55}to{transform:scale(1.16) rotate(10deg);opacity:1}}
.v36-secret-story{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:10px}
.v36-secret-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;text-align:left;min-width:0}
.v36-secret-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;align-self:flex-start;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff0c6,#ffe09a);border:1px solid #edc878;border-radius:999px;color:#8a5f26;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;padding:6px 12px}
.v36-secret-meta .v31-wizard-quote{margin:0}
.v36-secret-bonus{margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffdf0,#f6fff7);border:1px solid #dfc58e;border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;color:#73522f;text-align:left;line-height:1.65}
.v36-secret-bonus b{display:block;color:#9a6c2b;margin-bottom:6px}
@media (max-width:900px){
 .v36-guide-top span{display:none}
 .v36-pageArea{top:15.2%;bottom:13.4%;width:34.6%}
 .v36-pageArea.left{left:7.1%}
 .v36-pageArea.right{right:7.1%}
 .v36-pocket{border-radius:16px;padding:6px}
 .v36-pocket::before{border-radius:14px}
 .spark.v36-secret-book{width:78px;height:78px}
 .spark.v36-secret-book::before{width:102px;height:102px}
 .spark.v36-secret-book img{width:72px;height:72px}
 .v36-secret-story{flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
 .v36-secret-meta{text-align:center}
 .v36-secret-kicker{align-self:center}
}
@media (max-width:700px) and (orientation:portrait){
 #modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:100vw!important;height:100dvh!important;border-radius:0!important;max-height:none!important}
 #modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{padding:6px 6px 8px!important}
 .v36-guide-shell{gap:8px}
 .v36-guide-top{font-size:11px;padding:0 4px}
 .v36-book-stage{overflow:hidden}
 .v36-book-spread{width:min(calc(100dvh - 155px),1400px);max-width:none;max-height:none;transform:rotate(90deg)}
 .v36-guide-nav{gap:6px}
 .v36-guide-nav button{min-height:40px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px}
 .v36-guide-nav strong{order:1;width:100%;text-align:center}
 .v36-guide-nav .v36-return{order:4;width:100%;max-width:220px}
}


/* Ver.3.25 secret-book polish + update notification */
.updateNotice{position:fixed;left:50%;top:12px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9999;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:min(96vw,760px);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid #fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff8df,#ffefb8);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(43,27,8,.28);color:#6a4721;font-weight:900}
.updateNotice.show{display:flex}
.updateNoticeText{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0;line-height:1.4}
.updateNoticeText strong{font-size:15px;color:#80501f}
.updateNoticeText span{font-size:12px;color:#765535}
.updateNoticeActions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}
.updateNotice button{appearance:none;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid #e8c97e;background:#fff;padding:9px 14px;min-height:40px;font-weight:1000;color:#80501f;cursor:pointer}
.updateNotice button.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd972,#ffb84d);border-color:#f4c25e;color:#6e4103}
.updateNotice button.ghost{background:#fffdfa}
.updateCheckBtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px}
.v26-secret,.v26-secret.found{width:72px!important;height:72px!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;overflow:visible!important;padding:0!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;opacity:1!important}
.v26-secret::before,.v26-secret::after,.v31-book-mark,.v31-tome-label{display:none!important;content:none!important}
.v37-secret-shell{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,227,117,.96)) drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(255,192,89,.88))}
.v37-secret-shell::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,226,.98) 0%,rgba(255,243,168,.98) 16%,rgba(255,226,100,.78) 38%,rgba(255,207,69,.42) 58%,rgba(255,193,81,.15) 73%,transparent 78%);filter:blur(7px);animation:v37BookAura 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.v37-secret-shell::after{content:'✦';position:absolute;right:4px;top:2px;font-size:22px;line-height:1;color:#fff8bf;text-shadow:0 0 10px #ffe780,0 0 22px rgba(255,219,84,.95);animation:v37BookTwinkle 1.15s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v37-secret-shell img{position:relative;display:block;width:66px;height:66px;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(1.08) saturate(1.04);animation:v37BookFloat 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.v37-secret-done{position:absolute;right:-2px;top:-2px;background:#4bb181;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:1000;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 3px 9px rgba(31,117,83,.25)}
.v26-secret.found .v37-secret-shell{opacity:.92;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(177,255,203,.85)) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(118,219,156,.52))}
.v26-secret.found .v37-secret-shell::before{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(234,255,242,.95) 0%,rgba(186,255,214,.82) 24%,rgba(118,229,163,.4) 56%,transparent 76%)}
.v26-storage .v26-secret{top:auto!important;bottom:22px!important;right:18px!important;left:auto!important;transform:none!important}
.v26-wash .v26-secret{top:70px!important;right:26px!important;bottom:auto!important;left:auto!important;transform:none!important;z-index:6!important}
.v26-clean .v26-secret{right:22px!important;bottom:18px!important}
.v26-cook .v26-secret{right:18px!important;bottom:18px!important}
@keyframes v37BookAura{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.92);opacity:.82}50%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes v37BookFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-4deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(4deg)}}
@keyframes v37BookTwinkle{from{transform:scale(.84) rotate(-12deg);opacity:.5}to{transform:scale(1.18) rotate(10deg);opacity:1}}
@media(max-width:700px){.updateNotice{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px 12px 10px;top:8px}.updateNoticeActions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}.updateNotice button{min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px}}


/* Ver.3.25 binder + secret polish */
.v36-guide-shell{gap:8px!important;height:100%!important}
.v36-guide-top{padding:0 clamp(8px,1vw,12px)!important;gap:8px!important}
.v36-guide-top b,.v36-guide-top span{line-height:1.25}
.v36-book-stage{flex:1 1 auto!important;min-height:0!important;padding:0!important}
